<style data-shopify>
  .drawer-carousel-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0;
    position: relative;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--gap-2xs);
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;

    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar {

    height: 16px;
    width: 100%;

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__track {

    background-color: var(--color-foreground);

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb {

    z-index: 1;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: var(--color-primary);
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb::after {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -6px;
    width: 100%;
    height: 16px;
    content: "";
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-primary-hover);
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track {
    cursor: grab;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track[data-dragging] {
    cursor: grabbing;
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }
</style>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-AYmNPMFpwN2hiYXd5T__carousel_id');
      const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-AYmNPMFpwN2hiYXd5T__carousel_id');

      if (!track || !thumb) return;

      const updateScrollbar = () => {
        const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
        const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

        // Evitar cálculos matemáticos si el elemento está oculto (ancho 0)
        if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

        const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

        // Si no hay desbordamiento, oculta el scrollbar
        if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        } else {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }

        const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
        const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
        const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

        thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
        thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
      };

      // 1. Escuchar el scroll normal
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

      // 2. Usar ResizeObserver para detectar cuando el Drawer se abre o la pantalla cambia
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        updateScrollbar();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(track);

      // --- Drag-to-scroll en el track (solo mouse; touch usa scroll nativo del browser) ---
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;

        // Previene drag nativo de links/imágenes. A diferencia de pointerdown,
        // preventDefault en mousedown NO suprime el evento click posterior.
        e.preventDefault();

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startScrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const { signal } = controller;
        let moved = false;

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (moveEvent) => {
          const delta = startX - moveEvent.clientX;
          if (!delta) return;

          if (!moved) {
            moved = true;
            // setPointerCapture en el track (ancestro de los <a>) hace que pointerup
            // se dispare en el track, no en la card. El browser genera el click en el
            // elemento que recibió pointerup, así que las cards no reciben el click.
            track.setPointerCapture(moveEvent.pointerId);
            track.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
          }

          track.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft + delta;
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          controller.abort();
          track.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => controller.abort(), { signal });
      });

      // --- Drag del scrollbar thumb ---
      let isDragging = false;
      let startX;

      thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

      thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      });

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;

        const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
        const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

        const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
        const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

        let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

        const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
        track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (isDragging) {
          isDragging = false;
          document.body.style.userSelect = '';
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</div>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-AUHhkNUhNOVZUbGQrS__carousel_id');
      const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-AUHhkNUhNOVZUbGQrS__carousel_id');

      if (!track || !thumb) return;

      const updateScrollbar = () => {
        const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
        const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

        // Evitar cálculos matemáticos si el elemento está oculto (ancho 0)
        if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

        const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

        // Si no hay desbordamiento, oculta el scrollbar
        if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        } else {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }

        const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
        const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
        const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

        thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
        thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
      };

      // 1. Escuchar el scroll normal
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

      // 2. Usar ResizeObserver para detectar cuando el Drawer se abre o la pantalla cambia
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        updateScrollbar();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(track);

      // --- Drag-to-scroll en el track (solo mouse; touch usa scroll nativo del browser) ---
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;

        // Previene drag nativo de links/imágenes. A diferencia de pointerdown,
        // preventDefault en mousedown NO suprime el evento click posterior.
        e.preventDefault();

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startScrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const { signal } = controller;
        let moved = false;

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (moveEvent) => {
          const delta = startX - moveEvent.clientX;
          if (!delta) return;

          if (!moved) {
            moved = true;
            // setPointerCapture en el track (ancestro de los <a>) hace que pointerup
            // se dispare en el track, no en la card. El browser genera el click en el
            // elemento que recibió pointerup, así que las cards no reciben el click.
            track.setPointerCapture(moveEvent.pointerId);
            track.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
          }

          track.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft + delta;
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          controller.abort();
          track.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => controller.abort(), { signal });
      });

      // --- Drag del scrollbar thumb ---
      let isDragging = false;
      let startX;

      thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

      thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      });

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;

        const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
        const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

        const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
        const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

        let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

        const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
        track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (isDragging) {
          isDragging = false;
          document.body.style.userSelect = '';
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</div>

</div>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-AUDNVT3huWlJJN09pM__carousel_id');
      const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-AUDNVT3huWlJJN09pM__carousel_id');

      if (!track || !thumb) return;

      const updateScrollbar = () => {
        const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
        const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

        // Evitar cálculos matemáticos si el elemento está oculto (ancho 0)
        if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

        const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

        // Si no hay desbordamiento, oculta el scrollbar
        if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        } else {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }

        const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
        const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
        const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

        thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
        thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
      };

      // 1. Escuchar el scroll normal
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

      // 2. Usar ResizeObserver para detectar cuando el Drawer se abre o la pantalla cambia
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        updateScrollbar();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(track);

      // --- Drag-to-scroll en el track (solo mouse; touch usa scroll nativo del browser) ---
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;

        // Previene drag nativo de links/imágenes. A diferencia de pointerdown,
        // preventDefault en mousedown NO suprime el evento click posterior.
        e.preventDefault();

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startScrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const { signal } = controller;
        let moved = false;

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (moveEvent) => {
          const delta = startX - moveEvent.clientX;
          if (!delta) return;

          if (!moved) {
            moved = true;
            // setPointerCapture en el track (ancestro de los <a>) hace que pointerup
            // se dispare en el track, no en la card. El browser genera el click en el
            // elemento que recibió pointerup, así que las cards no reciben el click.
            track.setPointerCapture(moveEvent.pointerId);
            track.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
          }

          track.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft + delta;
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          controller.abort();
          track.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => controller.abort(), { signal });
      });

      // --- Drag del scrollbar thumb ---
      let isDragging = false;
      let startX;

      thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

      thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      });

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;

        const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
        const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

        const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
        const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

        let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

        const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
        track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (isDragging) {
          isDragging = false;
          document.body.style.userSelect = '';
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</div>

</div>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-AWUtTa1RKSk9oOGt0T__carousel_id');
      const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-AWUtTa1RKSk9oOGt0T__carousel_id');

      if (!track || !thumb) return;

      const updateScrollbar = () => {
        const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
        const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

        // Evitar cálculos matemáticos si el elemento está oculto (ancho 0)
        if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

        const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

        // Si no hay desbordamiento, oculta el scrollbar
        if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        } else {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }

        const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
        const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
        const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

        thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
        thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
      };

      // 1. Escuchar el scroll normal
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

      // 2. Usar ResizeObserver para detectar cuando el Drawer se abre o la pantalla cambia
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        updateScrollbar();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(track);

      // --- Drag-to-scroll en el track (solo mouse; touch usa scroll nativo del browser) ---
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;

        // Previene drag nativo de links/imágenes. A diferencia de pointerdown,
        // preventDefault en mousedown NO suprime el evento click posterior.
        e.preventDefault();

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startScrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const { signal } = controller;
        let moved = false;

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (moveEvent) => {
          const delta = startX - moveEvent.clientX;
          if (!delta) return;

          if (!moved) {
            moved = true;
            // setPointerCapture en el track (ancestro de los <a>) hace que pointerup
            // se dispare en el track, no en la card. El browser genera el click en el
            // elemento que recibió pointerup, así que las cards no reciben el click.
            track.setPointerCapture(moveEvent.pointerId);
            track.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
          }

          track.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft + delta;
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          controller.abort();
          track.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => controller.abort(), { signal });
      });

      // --- Drag del scrollbar thumb ---
      let isDragging = false;
      let startX;

      thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

      thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      });

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;

        const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
        const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

        const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
        const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

        let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

        const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
        track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (isDragging) {
          isDragging = false;
          document.body.style.userSelect = '';
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }
      });
    })();

  <div class="drawer-carousel-scrollbar" id="scrollbar-AcHBUV09xZFFlK05RT__carousel_id">
    <div class="drawer-carousel-scrollbar__track"></div>
    <div class="drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb" id="scrollbar-thumb-AcHBUV09xZFFlK05RT__carousel_id"></div>
  </div>

<style data-shopify>
  .drawer-carousel-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0;
    position: relative;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--gap-2xs);
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track > * {
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar {
    position: relative;
    height: 16px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__track {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 6px;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: var(--color-foreground);
    opacity: 0.2;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__track::after {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -6px;
    width: 100%;
    height: 16px;
    content: "";
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 6px;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    height: 2px;
    background-color: var(--color-primary);
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb::after {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -6px;
    width: 100%;
    height: 16px;
    content: "";
  }

  .drawer-carousel-scrollbar__thumb:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-primary-hover);
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track {
    cursor: grab;
  }

  .drawer-carousel-track[data-dragging] {
    cursor: grabbing;
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }
</style>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-AcHBUV09xZFFlK05RT__carousel_id');
      const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-AcHBUV09xZFFlK05RT__carousel_id');

      if (!track || !thumb) return;

      const updateScrollbar = () => {
        const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
        const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

        // Evitar cálculos matemáticos si el elemento está oculto (ancho 0)
        if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

        const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

        // Si no hay desbordamiento, oculta el scrollbar
        if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        } else {
          thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }

        const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
        const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
        const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
        const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

        thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
        thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
      };

      // 1. Escuchar el scroll normal
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

      // 2. Usar ResizeObserver para detectar cuando el Drawer se abre o la pantalla cambia
      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        updateScrollbar();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(track);

      // --- Drag-to-scroll en el track (solo mouse; touch usa scroll nativo del browser) ---
      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.button !== 0) return;

        // Previene drag nativo de links/imágenes. A diferencia de pointerdown,
        // preventDefault en mousedown NO suprime el evento click posterior.
        e.preventDefault();

        const startX = e.clientX;
        const startScrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const { signal } = controller;
        let moved = false;

        document.addEventListener('pointermove', (moveEvent) => {
          const delta = startX - moveEvent.clientX;
          if (!delta) return;

          if (!moved) {
            moved = true;
            // setPointerCapture en el track (ancestro de los <a>) hace que pointerup
            // se dispare en el track, no en la card. El browser genera el click en el
            // elemento que recibió pointerup, así que las cards no reciben el click.
            track.setPointerCapture(moveEvent.pointerId);
            track.setAttribute('data-dragging', '');
          }

          track.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft + delta;
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
          controller.abort();
          track.removeAttribute('data-dragging');
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }, { signal });

        document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => controller.abort(), { signal });
      });

      // --- Drag del scrollbar thumb ---
      let isDragging = false;
      let startX;

      thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

      thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
        document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      });

      document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (!isDragging) return;

        const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
        const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
        const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

        const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
        const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

        let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
        x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

        const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
        track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
      });

      document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (isDragging) {
          isDragging = false;
          document.body.style.userSelect = '';
          track.style.scrollBehavior = 'smooth';
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    // Get the clicked element
    var clickedElement = event.target;

    // Check if the clicked element is within the modal container
    var modal = document.querySelector('.md-modal__container');
    if (modal && modal.contains(clickedElement)) {
      // Handle clicks on country list items
      if (clickedElement.closest('#orbeCountryList li')) {
        var selectedCountry = clickedElement.closest('#orbeCountryList li').dataset.name;
        trackEvents('pop-up_pais', selectedCountry);
      }

      // Handle clicks on language list items
      if (clickedElement.closest('#orbeLanguageList li')) {
        var selectedLanguage = clickedElement.closest('#orbeLanguageList li').dataset.locale;
        trackEvents('pop-up_idioma', selectedLanguage);
      }

      // Handle click on the continue button
      if (clickedElement.closest('#md-btn__form__onSubmit')) {
        trackEvents('pop-up_idioma_pais', 'continue');
      }

      // Handle click on the close button
      if (clickedElement.closest('.md-modal-closeButton.md-modal-closeButtonAction')) {
        trackEvents('pop-up_idioma_pais', 'cerrar');
      }
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  // Tab switching
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    const tab = e.target.closest('.cart-member__tab');
    if (!tab) return;
    const wrapper = tab.closest('.cart-member__wrapper');
    if (!wrapper) return;
    const targetPanel = tab.dataset.memberTab;
    wrapper.querySelectorAll('.cart-member__tab').forEach((t) => {
      t.classList.toggle('cart-member__tab--active', t === tab);
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', t === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    wrapper.querySelectorAll('.cart-member__panel').forEach((panel) => {
      const isTarget = panel.id.endsWith('-' + targetPanel);
      panel.hidden = !isTarget;
      panel.classList.toggle('cart-member__panel--active', isTarget);
    });
    wrapper.querySelectorAll('.cart-member__feedback').forEach((f) => { f.hidden = true; });
  });

  // Validation
  document.addEventListener('click', async function(e) {
    const btn = e.target.closest('.cart-member__validate');
    if (!btn || btn.dataset.loading === 'true') return;

    const memberType = btn.dataset.memberType;
    // The FCB API expects "member" or "club"; "penya" maps to "club"
    const apiType = memberType === 'penya' ? 'club' : memberType;
    const panel = btn.closest('.cart-member__panel');
    const key = panel.querySelector('.cart-member__input[type="text"]')?.value?.trim();
    const pin = panel.querySelector('.cart-member__input[type="password"]')?.value?.trim();
    const feedback = panel.querySelector('.cart-member__feedback');
    const validateLabel = btn.textContent;

    if (!key || !pin) {
      showFeedback(feedback, 'wrong-key', false);
      return;
    }

    btn.dataset.loading = 'true';
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = '...';
    hideFeedback(feedback);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://api.fcbarcelona.com/shopify/api/clubs-and-members/validate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ type: apiType, key, pin }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();

      if (data.token) {
        await applyToken(data.token);
        showFeedback(feedback, 'success', true);
        await refreshCartSections();
      } else if (data.code) {
        await applyDiscountCode(data.code);
        showFeedback(feedback, 'success', true);
        await refreshCartSections();
      } else if (data.error) {
        showFeedback(feedback, mapError(data.error), false);
      } else {
        showFeedback(feedback, 'error', false);
      }
    } catch {
      showFeedback(feedback, 'error', false);
    } finally {
      btn.dataset.loading = 'false';
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = validateLabel;
    }
  });

  function mapError(error) {
    const map = {
      'Wrong key or PIN.': 'wrong-key',
      'Wrong type ("club" or "member")': 'wrong-type',
      "Can't validate error": 'wrong-validate',
      'Unable to login.': 'wrong-login',
    };
    return map[error] || 'error';
  }

  function showFeedback(feedback, msgKey, isSuccess) {
    feedback.hidden = false;
    feedback.classList.toggle('cart-member__feedback--success', isSuccess);
    feedback.classList.toggle('cart-member__feedback--error', !isSuccess);
    feedback.querySelectorAll('[data-msg]').forEach((span) => {
      span.hidden = span.dataset.msg !== msgKey;
    });
  }

  function hideFeedback(feedback) {
    feedback.hidden = true;
  }

  async function applyToken(token) {
    await fetch(Theme.routes.cart_update_url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ attributes: { __discount_token: token } }),
    });
  }

  async function applyDiscountCode(code) {
    // Keep the market/locale prefix: '/discount/CODE' on the root path resolves against
    // the primary market and resets the buyer's country/currency.
    await fetch('/'.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/discount/' + code);
  }

  async function refreshCartSections() {
    // Collect all section IDs before any DOM mutations
    const sectionIds = new Set();
    document.querySelectorAll('cart-items-component[data-section-id]').forEach((el) => {
      if (el.dataset.sectionId) sectionIds.add(el.dataset.sectionId);
    });

    for (const id of sectionIds) {
      try {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);
        url.searchParams.set('section_id', id);
        const res = await fetch(url.toString());
        if (!res.ok) continue;
        const html = await res.text();
        const newDoc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
        const newSection = newDoc.getElementById('shopify-section-' + id);
        const oldSection = document.getElementById('shopify-section-' + id);
        if (newSection && oldSection) oldSection.innerHTML = newSection.innerHTML;
      } catch {}
    }
  }
</script>

    <script>
      // Inline header height and menu style calculations to prevent layout shift
      // Note: Updates in calculateHeaderGroupHeight(), updateTransparentHeaderOffset() and setHeaderMenuStyle() utilities.js should be kept in sync with this function
      (function setHeaderHeighCustomProperties() {
        /*
         * Header calculation functions for maintaining CSS variables
         * Mimic calculateHeaderGroupHeight() in utilities.js
         */
        const header = document.querySelector('header-component');
        const headerGroup = document.querySelector('#header-group');
        const hasHeaderSection = headerGroup?.querySelector('.header-section');

        if (!header || !headerGroup) return;

        const headerTopRow = header.querySelector('.header__row--top');
        const headerHeight = header.offsetHeight;

        // Calculate the total height of the header group
        let headerGroupHeight = 0;
        const children = headerGroup.children;
        for (let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
          const element = children[i];
          if (element === header || !(element instanceof HTMLElement)) continue;
          headerGroupHeight += element.offsetHeight;
        }

        // Check for transparent header special case
        if (header.hasAttribute('transparent') && header.parentElement?.nextElementSibling) {
          headerGroupHeight += headerHeight;
        }

        // Set CSS variables
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-height', `${headerHeight}px`);
        document.body.style.setProperty('--header-group-height', `${headerGroupHeight}px`);

        if (headerTopRow) {
          window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            document.body.style.setProperty('--top-row-height', `${headerTopRow.offsetHeight}px`);
          });
        }

        /**
         * Updates CSS custom properties for transparent header offset calculation
         * Mimic updateTransparentHeaderOffset() in utilities.js
         */

        if (!hasHeaderSection || !header?.hasAttribute('transparent')) {
          document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', '0');
          return;
        }

        const hasImmediateSection = hasHeaderSection.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('shopify-section');

        const shouldApplyOffset = !hasImmediateSection ? '1' : '0';
        document.body.style.setProperty('--transparent-header-offset-boolean', shouldApplyOffset);
      })();

      (function setHeaderMenuStyle() {
        const headerComponent = document.querySelector('#header-component');
        if (headerComponent) {
          const isTouchDevice = 'ontouchstart' in window && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0;
          const overflowList = headerComponent?.querySelector('overflow-list');
          const hasReachedMinimum = overflowList && overflowList.hasAttribute('minimum-reached');
          headerComponent.dataset.menuStyle = isTouchDevice || hasReachedMinimum ? 'drawer' : 'menu';
        }
      })();
    </script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-965612621 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-965612621::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-965612621');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-965612621');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-974934289');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-974934289');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-983718230 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-983718230::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;

</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-983718230');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-983718230');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-989289948');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-989289948');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-002174777 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-002174777::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-002174777');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-002174777');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-007356604 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-007356604::-webkit-scrollbar {

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-007356604');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-007356604');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-016711951');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-016711951');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-021494131 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-021494131::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-021494131');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-021494131');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-026847110');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-026847110');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-037243501 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-037243501::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-037243501');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-037243501');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-041757015');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-041757015');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-055072633 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-055072633::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-055072633');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-055072633');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-062072991 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-062072991::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-062072991');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-062072991');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-068903473');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-068903473');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-084931438 {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
  }

  #carousel-track-084931438::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
</style>



<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-084931438');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-084931438');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const track = document.getElementById('carousel-track-089828253');
    const thumb = document.getElementById('scrollbar-thumb-089828253');

    if (!track || !thumb) return;

    const updateScrollbar = () => {
      const scrollWidth = track.scrollWidth;
      const clientWidth = track.clientWidth;

      if (clientWidth === 0 || scrollWidth === 0) return;

      const scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
      const thumbWidth = Math.max((clientWidth / scrollWidth) * 100, 10);

      if (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      } else {
        thumb.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
      }

      const maxScrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth;
      const scrollPercentage = scrollLeft / maxScrollLeft;
      const maxThumbLeft = 100 - thumbWidth;
      const thumbLeft = scrollPercentage * maxThumbLeft;

      thumb.style.width = `${thumbWidth}%`;
      thumb.style.left = `${thumbLeft}%`;
    };

    track.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollbar);

    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      updateScrollbar();
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(track);

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX;

    thumb.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => e.preventDefault());

    thumb.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.clientX - thumb.getBoundingClientRect().left;
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

      // Optimizamos el scroll nativo mientras arrastramos el thumb
      track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      track.style.scrollSnapType = 'none'; // Desactivamos el snap nativo de slideshow.js temporalmente para fluidez
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;

      const scrollbarContainer = thumb.parentElement;
      const scrollbarWidth = scrollbarContainer.clientWidth;
      const maxScrollLeft = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;

      const thumbWidthPx = (parseFloat(thumb.style.width) / 100) * scrollbarWidth;
      const maxThumbLeftPx = scrollbarWidth - thumbWidthPx;

      let x = e.clientX - scrollbarContainer.getBoundingClientRect().left - startX;
      x = Math.max(0, Math.min(x, maxThumbLeftPx));

      const scrollPercentage = x / maxThumbLeftPx;
      track.scrollLeft = scrollPercentage * maxScrollLeft;
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      if (isDragging) {
        isDragging = false;
        document.body.style.userSelect = '';
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
        track.style.scrollSnapType = ''; // Restauramos el snap
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<style>
  /* Ocultamos el scroll nativo únicamente para este track específico */
  #carousel-track-099840724 {

    -ms-overflow-style: none;
