          var isAllowed = window.Shopify.customerPrivacy.analyticsProcessingAllowed();
          cached = isAllowed;
          return isAllowed;
        } catch (e) {
          return null;
        }
      }

      function startRetry() {
        if (retryStarted) return;
        retryStarted = true;
        var tries = 0;
        var t = setInterval(function () {
          tries++;
          if (hasFn()) {
            readNow();
            clearInterval(t);
            return;
          }
          if (tries >= 60) {
            clearInterval(t);
          }
        }, 50);
      }

      return function () {
        if (hasFn()) return readNow();
        if (cached !== null) return cached;

        startRetry();
        return null; // This will trigger the 'false' default in IM.track
      };
    })();

    IM.getActiveCurrency = function () {
      try {
        var c = document.documentElement.getAttribute('currency');
        if (c) return String(c).toLowerCase();
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.currency && window.Shopify.currency.active)
          return String(window.Shopify.currency.active).toLowerCase();
        if (window.Shopify && window.Shopify.currency && window.Shopify.currency.currency)
          return String(window.Shopify.currency.currency).toLowerCase();
        if (window.Shopify && typeof window.Shopify.currency === 'string')
          return String(window.Shopify.currency).toLowerCase();
      } catch (e) {}
      return 'not apply';
    };

    IM.initFirstEntryUrl = function () {
      var KEY = '__im_utm_full_first';
      var existing = IM.storageGet(KEY);
      if (typeof existing === 'string' && existing.length) return;

      var fromKit = IM.storageGet('kit_utm_full');
      fromKit = typeof fromKit === 'string' ? fromKit.trim() : '';

      var url = '';
      if (fromKit && fromKit.indexOf('web-pixels') === -1) url = fromKit;
      else {
        try {
          url = String(window.location.href || '');
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (url && url.indexOf('web-pixels') === -1) IM.storageSet(KEY, url);
    };

    IM.getFirstEntryUrl = function () {
      var v = IM.storageGet('__im_utm_full_first');
      return typeof v === 'string' && v.length ? v : '';
    };

    IM.getUTM = function () {
      var q = IM.parseQuery(window.location.search);
      var keys = [
        'ext', // Added tracking_code/ext here for persistence
        'utm_source',
        'utm_medium',
        'utm_campaign',
        'utm_content',
        'utm_term',
        'gclid',
        'fbclid',
        'msclkid',
        'ttclid',
      ];

      var storedRaw = IM.storageGet('__im_utm');
      var stored = {};
      if (storedRaw) stored = IM.safeJsonParse(storedRaw) || {};

      var current = {};
      var changed = false;

      for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
        var k = keys[i];
        var v = q[k];
        // Logic: If in URL, update storage. If NOT in URL, use stored value.
        if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length) {
          current[k] = v;
          changed = true;
        } else if (stored && typeof stored[k] === 'string' && stored[k].length) {
          current[k] = stored[k];
        } else {
          current[k] = '';
        }
      }

      if (changed) {
        try {
          IM.storageSet('__im_utm', JSON.stringify(current));
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      return {
        tracking_code: IM.notApply(current.ext || ''), // Map ext to tracking_code
        utm_source: IM.notApply(current.utm_source || ''),
        utm_medium: IM.notApply(current.utm_medium || ''),
        utm_campaign: IM.notApply(current.utm_campaign || ''),
        utm_content: IM.notApply(current.utm_content || ''),
        utm_term: IM.notApply(current.utm_term || ''),
        gclid: IM.notApply(current.gclid || ''),
        fbclid: IM.notApply(current.fbclid || ''),
        msclkid: IM.notApply(current.msclkid || ''),
        ttclid: IM.notApply(current.ttclid || ''),
        utm_full: IM.notApply(IM.getFirstEntryUrl()),
      };
    };
    IM.countryToEnglish = function (code) {
      if (!code) return null;
      try {
        var dn = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' });
        var name = dn.of(String(code).toUpperCase());
        if (name) return name;
      } catch (e) {}
      return String(code).toUpperCase();
    };
    IM.languageToEnglish = function (code) {
      if (!code) return null;
      try {
        var dn = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'language' });
        var name = dn.of(String(code).toLowerCase());
        if (name) return name;
      } catch (e) {}
      return String(code).toLowerCase();
    };

    IM.buildContext = function () {
      var utm = IM.getUTM();
      var q = IM.parseQuery(window.location.search);
      var searchTerm = q.q || '';

      return {
        page_name: IM.notApply(
          (function () {
            var path = window.location.pathname.replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}(\/|$)/, '/').replace(/\/$/, '');
            if (path === '' || path === '/') return 'home';
            return path;
          })() || document.title
        ),
        page_url: String(window.location.href || ''),
        page_type: IM.getPageType(),
        country: IM.notApply(IM.countryToEnglish(document.documentElement.getAttribute('country'))),
        language: IM.notApply(IM.languageToEnglish(document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang'))),
        cookies_consent: IM.getConsentAnalytics(),
        tracking_code: utm.tracking_code,
        utm_source: utm.utm_source,
        utm_source: utm.utm_source,
        utm_medium: utm.utm_medium,
        utm_campaign: utm.utm_campaign,
        utm_content: utm.utm_content,
        utm_term: utm.utm_term,
        gclid: utm.gclid,
        utm_full: utm.utm_full,
        fbclid: utm.fbclid,
        msclkid: utm.msclkid,
        ttclid: utm.ttclid,
        layout: IM.getLayout(),
        date: (function () {
          var now = new Date();
          var offset = -now.getTimezoneOffset();
          var sign = offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
          var pad = function (n) {
            return String(Math.floor(Math.abs(n))).padStart(2, '0');
          };
          return (
            now.getFullYear() +
            '-' +
            pad(now.getMonth() + 1) +
            '-' +
            pad(now.getDate()) +
            'T' +
            pad(now.getHours()) +
            ':' +
            pad(now.getMinutes()) +
            ':' +
            pad(now.getSeconds()) +
            '.' +
            String(now.getMilliseconds()).padStart(3, '0') +
            sign +
            pad(offset / 60) +
            ':' +
            pad(offset % 60)
          );
        })(),
        previous_page: IM.notApply(document.referrer),
        days_since_visit: IM.notApply(
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.days_since_visit != null
            ? window.kitAnalyticsMeta.days_since_visit
            : null
        ),
      };
    };
    IM.buildMiniBagItems = function () {
      try {
        if (!window.fcbDL || !Array.isArray(window.fcbDL.cart?.items)) {
          return [];
        }

        return window.fcbDL.cart.items.map(function (item, index) {
          return {
            item_sku: IM.notApply(item.sku),
            item_id: IM.notApply(item.product_id || item.id),
            item_name: IM.notApply(item.title),
            price: IM.notApply(IM.toNumber(item.price)),
            quantity: IM.notApply(item.quantity || 1),
            item_size: IM.notApply(item.variant_title || null),
            item_brand: IM.notApply(item.vendor || null),
            item_list_type: 'minibag',
            index: index + 1,
            personalized_item: IM.notApply(item.properties && item.properties.name ? 'yes' : 'no'),
          };
        });
      } catch (e) {
        return [];
      }
    };

    IM.getIdentity = function () {
      var raw = IM.storageGet('__im_identity');
      if (!raw) return {};
      return IM.safeJsonParse(raw) || {};
    };

    IM.setIdentity = function (obj) {
      try {
        IM.storageSet('__im_identity', JSON.stringify(obj || {}));
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    IM.toHex = function (buffer) {
      var bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer);
      var hex = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        var s = bytes[i].toString(16);
        if (s.length === 1) s = '0' + s;
        hex += s;
      }
      return hex;
    };

    IM.sha256Hex = function (text) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        try {
          if (
            window.crypto &&
            window.crypto.subtle &&
            typeof window.TextEncoder !== 'undefined' &&
            typeof window.crypto.subtle.digest === 'function'
          ) {
            var enc = new TextEncoder();
            var buf = enc.encode(String(text));
            window.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buf).then(
              function (hash) {
                resolve(IM.toHex(hash));
              },
              function () {
                resolve('not apply');
              }
            );
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        resolve('not apply');
      });
    };

    IM.cleanEmail = function (v) {
      return String(v || '')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();
    };

    IM.cleanPhone = function (v) {
      return String(v || '')
        .replace(/[^\d+]/g, '')
        .trim();
    };
    IM.reset = function () {
      var dl = window.dataLayerIM;
      var resetPayload = { ecommerce: null, eventData: null };
      dl.push(resetPayload);
      return resetPayload;
    };

    IM.push = function (eventName, payload) {
      var dl = window.dataLayerIM;
      var resetRef = IM.reset();

      var finalPayload = {
        event: eventName,
        context: payload.context || {},
        user: payload.user || {},
        eventData: payload.eventData || {},
        ecommerce: payload.ecommerce || null,
      };

      IM.log('[dataLayerIM] push', finalPayload);
      dl.push(finalPayload);

      try {
        var resetIndex = dl.lastIndexOf(resetRef);
        if (resetIndex > -1) dl.splice(resetIndex, 1);
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    IM.getBundledTotals = function () {
      var items = IM.buildCartItemsFromMeta();
      var totalQty = 0;
      var totalVal = 0;

      if (Array.isArray(items)) {
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          var item = items[i];
          var q = 0;
          if (typeof item.quantity === 'number') q = item.quantity;
          else if (item.quantity !== 'not apply') q = parseFloat(item.quantity);
          if (isNaN(q)) q = 0;

          var p = 0;
          if (typeof item.price === 'number') p = item.price;
          else if (item.price !== 'not apply') p = parseFloat(item.price);
          if (isNaN(p)) p = 0;

          totalQty += q;
          totalVal += p * q;
        }
      }

      if (
        totalQty === 0 &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart.item_count > 0
      ) {
        var snap = IM.cart.getSnapshot();
        return { quantity: snap.cart_quantity, value: snap.cart_value };
      }

      return {
        quantity: totalQty,
        value: IM.round2(totalVal),
      };
    };

    IM.buildEcommerce = function (cfg) {
      var o = cfg || {};

      if (o.noCart) {
        return {
          transaction_id: IM.notApply(null),
          value: IM.notApply(null),
          currency: IM.notApply(null),
          items: Array.isArray(o.items) ? o.items : [],
          payment_method: IM.notApply(null),
          payment_gateway: IM.notApply(null),
          shipping_country: IM.notApply(null),
          shipping_tax: IM.notApply(null),
          coupon: IM.notApply(null),
          discount_type: IM.notApply(null),
        };
      }

      var bundledCartItems = IM.buildCartItemsFromMeta();
      var totalQty = 0;
      var totalVal = 0;

      if (Array.isArray(bundledCartItems)) {
        for (var i = 0; i < bundledCartItems.length; i++) {
          var item = bundledCartItems[i];
          var q = 0;
          if (typeof item.quantity === 'number') q = item.quantity;
          else if (item.quantity && item.quantity !== 'not apply') q = parseFloat(item.quantity);
          if (isNaN(q)) q = 0;

          var p = 0;
          if (typeof item.price === 'number') p = item.price;
          else if (item.price && item.price !== 'not apply') p = parseFloat(item.price);
          if (isNaN(p)) p = 0;

          totalQty += q;
          totalVal += p * q;
        }
      }

      if (
        totalQty === 0 &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart &&
        window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart.item_count > 0
      ) {
        var snap = IM.cart.getSnapshot();
        totalQty = snap.cart_quantity;
        totalVal = snap.cart_value;
      }

      var eventItems = Array.isArray(o.items) ? o.items : [];

      return {
        transaction_id: IM.notApply(o.transaction_id || null),
        value: IM.notApply(
          typeof o.value === 'number' ? IM.round2(o.value) : o.value != null ? IM.toNumber(o.value) : null
        ),
        currency: IM.notApply((o.currency ? String(o.currency) : null) || IM.getActiveCurrency()),
        items: eventItems,
        cart_quantity: totalQty,
        cart_value: IM.round2(totalVal),
        payment_method: IM.notApply(o.payment_method || null),
        payment_gateway: IM.notApply(o.payment_gateway || null),
        shipping_country: IM.notApply(o.shipping_country || null),
        shipping_tax: IM.notApply(o.shipping_tax || null),
        coupon: IM.notApply(o.coupon || null),
        discount_type: IM.notApply(o.discount_type || null),
      };
    };
    IM.selectItem = function initSelectItem() {
      if (window.__im_select_item_init_debug) return;
      window.__im_select_item_init_debug = true;

      var _lastSelectItemKey = null;
      var _lastSelectItemTime = 0;

      function resolveListType(card) {
        if (card.closest('.predictive-search')) {
          return null;
        }
        if (card.closest('header')) return 'header';
        return IM.getPageType();
      }

      function getIndex(card) {
        try {
          var li = card.closest('li');
          if (li && li.parentNode) {
            return Array.prototype.indexOf.call(li.parentNode.children, li) + 1;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          IM.log('[select_item] index error', e);
        }
        return 1;
      }

      document.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function (e) {
          var target = e.target;
          if (!target || !target.closest) return;

          // Skip interactive non-navigation elements (swatches, add-to-cart buttons, etc.)
          if (target.closest('button, input, label, select, [role="button"]')) return;

          var card = target.closest('product-card');
          if (!card) return;

          var script = card.querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='product-impression']");
          if (!script) return;

          var product = IM.safeJsonParse(script.textContent);
          if (!product) return;

          var isCompleteLook = !!(card.closest('.complete-look-section') || card.closest('product-recommendations'));
          var listType = isCompleteLook ? document.title : resolveListType ? resolveListType(card) : IM.getPageType();
          var action = isCompleteLook ? 'click_item' : 'select_item';
          if (!listType) return;

          if (!IM.lists || typeof IM.lists.buildItemFromCard !== 'function') {
            return;
          }

          // Deduplication guard: skip if the same product+list fired select_item within 300ms
          var productId = product.product_id || product.id;
          var dedupeKey = productId ? String(productId) + '|' + listType : null;
          var now = Date.now();
          if (dedupeKey && dedupeKey === _lastSelectItemKey && now - _lastSelectItemTime < 300) return;
          _lastSelectItemKey = dedupeKey;
          _lastSelectItemTime = now;

          var index = getIndex(card);

          var item = IM.lists.buildItemFromCard(card, listType, index);

          IM.track('select_item', {
            events: ['select_item', 'event170'],
            event_action: action,
            event_location: listType,
            ecommerce: {
              items: [item],
            },
          });
        },
        true
      );
    };

    IM.track = function (eventName, cfg) {
      var o = cfg || {};
      var context = o.context || IM.buildContext();
      var user = o.user || IM.buildUser();

      var eventData = o.eventData || {};
      if (!eventData.events) eventData.events = IM.notApply(o.events || eventName);
      if (!eventData.event_location) eventData.event_location = IM.notApply(o.event_location || context.page_type);
      if (!eventData.event_action) eventData.event_action = IM.notApply(o.event_action || 'not apply');

      // --- CORRECCIÓN DE LA LÓGICA DE INTERCEPTOR ---
      if (eventName === 'add_to_cart' && window.blockNextGeneralAddToCart) {
        // Bloqueamos el evento genérico proveniente del interceptor (minibag o bag)
        var isInterceptorEvent = eventData.event_location === 'minibag' || eventData.event_location === 'bag';

        if (isInterceptorEvent) {
          IM.log('[Analytics Interceptor] Bloqueado add_to_cart duplicado proveniente de minibag/bag');

          // Reset the lock so subsequent organic clicks work
          window.blockNextGeneralAddToCart = false;

          // STOP THE PUSH DEL EVENTO GENÉRICO
          return;
        }
      }
      // ----------------------------------------------------------------

      if (!eventData.item_size && o.item_size) {
        eventData.item_size = IM.notApply(o.item_size);
      }

      // Map specific params to eventData
      if (o.collection_name) eventData.collection_name = IM.notApply(o.collection_name);
      if (o.widget_name) eventData.widget_name = IM.notApply(o.widget_name);
      if (o.cta_name) eventData.cta_name = IM.notApply(o.cta_name);
      if (o.search_term) eventData.search_term = IM.notApply(o.search_term);
      if (o.footer_name) eventData.footer_name = IM.notApply(o.footer_name);

      var ecommerce = null;
      if (o.ecommerce === null) ecommerce = null;
      else ecommerce = IM.buildEcommerce(o.ecommerce || {});

      var payload = IM.stripNotApply(
        {
          context: context,
          user: user,
          eventData: eventData,
          ecommerce: ecommerce,
        },
        false
      );

      if (!o.immediate && eventName && typeof eventName === 'string' && eventName.indexOf('view') > -1) {
        IM._pageViewDone.then(function () {
          IM.waitFor(
            function () {
              try {
                var shopifyReady = !!(window.Shopify && window.Shopify.customerPrivacy);
                var didomiReady = !!(
                  window.dataLayerIM &&
                  window.dataLayerIM.some(function (e) {
                    return (
                      (e.event === 'didomi-ready' || e.event === 'didomi-consent') &&
                      e.didomiVendorsConsent &&
                      e.didomiVendorsConsent.length > 0
                    );
                  })
                );
                return shopifyReady && didomiReady;
              } catch (e) {
                return false;
              }
            },
            { timeout: 5000, interval: 50 }
          ).then(function () {
            // Leer consent directamente de dataLayerIM
            var finalConsent = false;
            var foundDidomiEvent = false;
            try {
              var dl = window.dataLayerIM || [];
              for (var i = dl.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                var ev = dl[i];
                if (ev.event === 'didomi-consent' || ev.event === 'didomi-ready') {
                  finalConsent = typeof ev.didomiVendorsConsent === 'string' && ev.didomiVendorsConsent.length > 0;
                  foundDidomiEvent = true;
                  break;
                }
              }
            } catch (e) {}
            // FIX: si Didomi no ha escrito (a tiempo, o nunca) un evento didomi-consent/
            // didomi-ready en dataLayerIM -algo habitual en la primera carga de la
            // sesion, mientras Didomi todavia esta inicializando su propio script-,
            // antes se asumia "false" a ciegas. Ahora caemos a Shopify.customerPrivacy
            // (fuente oficial, ya con el fix de estabilizacion) en vez de dar por hecho
            // que no hay consentimiento.
            if (!foundDidomiEvent) {
              var shopifyConsent = IM.getConsentAnalytics();
              finalConsent = typeof shopifyConsent === 'boolean' ? shopifyConsent : false;
            }
            payload.context.cookies_consent = finalConsent;
            IM.push(eventName, payload);
          });
        });
      } else {
        // Push immediately: non-view events, or view events with immediate: true
        // (used when consent is already known, to guarantee firing order)
        if (o.immediate) {
          var finalConsentImmediate = IM.getConsentAnalytics();
          payload.context.cookies_consent = typeof finalConsentImmediate === 'boolean' ? finalConsentImmediate : false;
        }
        IM.push(eventName, payload);
      }
    };
    IM.waitFor = function (testFn, options) {
      var o = options || {};
      var timeout = typeof o.timeout === 'number' ? o.timeout : 4000;
      var interval = typeof o.interval === 'number' ? o.interval : 50;

      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        var start = Date.now();
        var t = setInterval(function () {
          var ok = false;
          try {
            ok = !!testFn();
          } catch (e) {}
          if (ok) {
            clearInterval(t);
            resolve(true);
            return;
          }
          if (Date.now() - start >= timeout) {
            clearInterval(t);
            resolve(false);
          }
        }, interval);
      });
    };

    IM.readUserFromGlobals = function () {
      try {
        if (window.fcbDL && window.fcbDL.user && typeof window.fcbDL.user === 'object') {
          var u = window.fcbDL.user;
          return {
            id: typeof u.id !== 'undefined' && u.id !== null ? u.id : null,
            type: typeof u.type === 'string' ? u.type : null,
            hashed_email: typeof u.hashed_email === 'string' ? u.hashed_email : null,
            phone: typeof u.phone === 'string' ? u.phone : null,
          };
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      try {
        if (
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta &&
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user &&
          typeof window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user === 'object'
        ) {
          var u2 = window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user;
          return {
            id: typeof u2.id !== 'undefined' && u2.id !== null ? u2.id : null,
            type: typeof u2.type === 'string' ? u2.type : null,
            hashed_email: typeof u2.hashed_email === 'string' ? u2.hashed_email : null,
            email: typeof u2.email === 'string' ? u2.email : null,
            phone: typeof u2.phone === 'string' ? u2.phone : null,
          };
        }
      } catch (e2) {}

      return null;
    };

    IM.prefillIdentityFromGlobals = function () {
      try {
        var g = IM.readUserFromGlobals();
        if (!g) return;

        var stored = IM.getIdentity() || {};
        var changed = false;

        // FIX: g.hashed_email (viene de fcbDL, calculado de forma async y
        // SIEMPRE referido al usuario logado actual) es la fuente de verdad.
        // Antes solo rellenabamos el hueco si stored.email_sha256 estaba vacio,
        // lo que dejaba "pegado" para siempre un hash de una sesion anterior
        // (ej. tras cambiar de cuenta en el mismo navegador). Ahora, si tenemos
        // un hashed_email en vivo que difiere del cacheado, lo sobreescribimos.
        if (g.hashed_email && stored.email_sha256 !== g.hashed_email) {
          stored.email_sha256 = g.hashed_email;
          changed = true;
        } else if (!stored.email_sha256 && !g.hashed_email && g.email) {
          // kit-analytics.liquid expone tambien el email en claro; si fcbDL
          // todavia no ha calculado el hash, lo hasheamos aqui nosotros mismos
          // como red de seguridad (se sobreescribira con el valor de fcbDL
          // en cuanto este disponible, gracias a la rama de arriba).
          var em = IM.cleanEmail(g.email);
          IM.sha256Hex(em).then(function (h) {
            if (!h || h === 'not apply') return;
            var s = IM.getIdentity() || {};
            if (!s.email_sha256) {
              s.email_sha256 = h;
              IM.setIdentity(s);
            }
          });
        }

        if (!stored.phone_sha256 && g.phone) {
          var p = IM.cleanPhone(g.phone);
          IM.sha256Hex(p).then(function (h) {
            if (!h || h === 'not apply') return;
            var s = IM.getIdentity() || {};
            if (!s.phone_sha256) {
              s.phone_sha256 = h;
              if (g.hashed_email && s.email_sha256 !== g.hashed_email) s.email_sha256 = g.hashed_email;
              IM.setIdentity(s);
            }
          });
        }

        if (changed) IM.setIdentity(stored);
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    IM.buildCartItemsFromMeta = function () {
      try {
        var cart = window.kitAnalyticsMeta && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart;
        if (!cart || !Array.isArray(cart.items)) return [];

        var bundles = {};
        var singles = [];

        cart.items.forEach(function (item) {
          var props = item.properties || {};
          var bundleId = props._bundle_id;

          if (!bundleId) {
            singles.push(item);
            return;
          }

          if (!bundles[bundleId]) bundles[bundleId] = [];
          bundles[bundleId].push(item);
        });

        var result = [];

        Object.keys(bundles).forEach(function (bundleId) {
          var bundleItems = bundles[bundleId];

          var baseItem = null;
          var basePrice = 0;
          var patchPrice = 0;
          var playerPrice = 0;
          var patch = null;
          var player = null;

          bundleItems.forEach(function (i) {
            var linePrice = IM.toNumber(i.final_line_price != null ? i.final_line_price : i.price) / 100;

            if (i.vendor !== 'BLM FCB') {
              baseItem = i;
              basePrice += linePrice;
              return;
            }
            if (i.product_type == 'Badge') {
              patchPrice += linePrice;
              patch = i.title;
              return;
            }

            if (i.properties && i.properties.name) {
              playerPrice += linePrice;
              player = i.properties.name;
            }
          });

          if (!baseItem) return;

          var item = IM.mapCartItemToIMItem(baseItem, baseItem.quantity || 1);

          item.original_price = IM.notApply(IM.round2(basePrice));
          item.price_patch = IM.notApply(IM.round2(patchPrice));
          item.price_player = IM.notApply(IM.round2(playerPrice));
          item.price = IM.notApply(IM.round2(basePrice + patchPrice + playerPrice));

          item.patch = IM.notApply(patch);
          item.player = IM.notApply(player);
          item.personalized_item = 'yes';

          result.push(item);
        });

        singles.forEach(function (i) {
          // Bug 11: filter out Customization and Badge standalone items
          if (i.product_type === 'Customization' || i.product_type === 'Badge') return;
          result.push(IM.mapCartItemToIMItem(i, i.quantity || 1));
        });

        // Bug 14: strip _helpers from all items
        return result.map(function (item) {
          var clean = {};
          for (var k in item) {
            if (k !== '_helpers' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(item, k)) {
              clean[k] = item[k];
            }
          }
          return clean;
        });
      } catch (e) {
        return [];
      }
    };

    // NUEVO: detección de visitante nuevo/recurrente basada en si el navegador
    // ya visitó el sitio antes (independiente de login y de historial de compras)
    IM.getVisitorType = (function () {
      // FIX: esta funcion tiene un efecto secundario (marca localStorage la
      // primera vez que se llama). Como IM.buildUser() se ejecuta en CADA
      // evento de la pagina (page_view, view_item_list, select_item...), sin
      // memorizar el resultado la 2a llamada en adelante siempre devolvia
      // "Repeat" -incluso en la primerisima visita en incognito- porque la
      // marca ya la habia puesto la 1a llamada de esa misma carga de pagina.
      var cachedForThisPageLoad = null;
      return function () {
        if (cachedForThisPageLoad !== null) return cachedForThisPageLoad;
        var KEY = '__im_returning_visitor';
        try {
          var existing = IM.storageGet(KEY); // localStorage
          if (existing) {
            cachedForThisPageLoad = 'Repeat';
          } else {
            IM.storageSet(KEY, '1');
            cachedForThisPageLoad = 'New Visitor';
          }
        } catch (e) {
          cachedForThisPageLoad = 'not apply';
        }
        return cachedForThisPageLoad;
      };
    })();

    IM.buildUser = function () {
      var stored = IM.getIdentity() || {};
      var c = IM.customer;
      var g = IM.readUserFromGlobals();

      var liquidId = c && c.id ? c.id : null;
      var globalId = g && g.id ? g.id : null;
      var userId = liquidId || globalId || null;

      var globalLogged = g && g.type ? String(g.type).toLowerCase() : '';
      var isLogged = !!liquidId || !!globalId || globalLogged === 'logged';

      // FIX: priorizar el hashed_email EN VIVO (g) sobre el cacheado (stored),
      // para no arrastrar un hash de otra cuenta/sesion anterior en este navegador.
      var emailSha = (g && g.hashed_email) || stored.email_sha256 || null;
      var phoneSha = stored.phone_sha256 || null;

      var ordersCount = null;
      try {
        var meta = window.kitAnalyticsMeta && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user;
        if (meta && meta.orders_count != null) {
          ordersCount = parseInt(meta.orders_count, 10);
          if (isNaN(ordersCount)) ordersCount = null;
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      // FIX: user_type (evar8) = nuevo/recurrente VISITANTE del sitio.
      // Ya NO depende de si está logueado ni de si ha comprado antes.
      var userType = IM.getVisitorType();

      // FIX: umbral correcto para "es su primera compra o no" (antes era <=1)
      var userCustomerType = IM.notApply(null);
      if (isLogged && ordersCount !== null) {
        userCustomerType = ordersCount === 0 ? 'Nuevo' : 'Repetido';
      }

      var userCustomerFrequency = IM.notApply(null);
      if (isLogged && ordersCount !== null) {
        if (ordersCount === 0) {
          userCustomerFrequency = 'Nuevo';
        } else {
          var lastOrderDate = window.kitAnalyticsMeta?.user?.last_order_date;
          var monthsSinceLastOrder = lastOrderDate
            ? (Date.now() - new Date(lastOrderDate).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30)
            : 999;
          if (monthsSinceLastOrder > 12) {
            userCustomerFrequency = 'Dormido';
          } else if (ordersCount === 1) {
            userCustomerFrequency = 'Activo';
          } else {
            userCustomerFrequency = 'Recurrente';
          }
        }
      }

      var userPurchaseAmount = IM.notApply(null);
      if (isLogged && ordersCount !== null) {
        userPurchaseAmount = ordersCount;
      }

      return {
        user_id: IM.notApply(userId != null ? String(userId) : null),
        user_logged: isLogged ? 'logged' : 'unlogged',
        user_type: userType,
        user_email_sha256: IM.notApply(emailSha),
        user_phone_sha256: IM.notApply(phoneSha),
        user_customer_type: userCustomerType,
        user_customer_frequency: userCustomerFrequency,
        user_purchase_amount: userPurchaseAmount,
      };
    };

    IM.modalCurrencyLanguageView = (function () {
      var MODAL_ID = 'md-app-embed__modal';
      var fired = false;
      var observer = null;

      function isVisible(el) {
        if (!el) return false;
        var style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
        return style && style.display === 'block';
      }

      function firePageView() {
        if (fired) return;
        fired = true;

        IM.track('page_view', {
          events: ['page_view', 'event4'],
          event_action: 'page_view',
          event_location: 'modal',
          ecommerce: null,
        });
      }

      function reset() {
        fired = false;
      }

      function observe(el) {
        observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
          if (isVisible(el)) {
            firePageView();
          } else {
            reset();
          }
        });

        observer.observe(el, {
          attributes: true,
          attributeFilter: ['style', 'class'],
        });
      }

      function init() {
        IM.waitFor(
          function () {
            return document.getElementById(MODAL_ID);
          },
          { timeout: 10000, interval: 100 }
        ).then(function (ok) {
          if (!ok) return;

          var el = document.getElementById(MODAL_ID);
          observe(el);
        });
      }

      return {
        init: init,
      };
    })();

    IM.cartInterceptor = (function () {
      var originalFetch = window.fetch;
      var before = null;
      var prevItems = null;

      if (window.__im_cart_interceptor_init) return;
      window.__im_cart_interceptor_init = true;

      function isCartMutation(url) {
        return (
          typeof url === 'string' &&
          (url.indexOf('/cart/add') > -1 || url.indexOf('/cart/change') > -1 || url.indexOf('/cart/update') > -1)
        );
      }

      function snapshot(cart) {
        var map = {};
        if (!cart || !Array.isArray(cart.items)) return map;

        for (var i = 0; i < cart.items.length; i++) {
          var it = cart.items[i];
          map[it.key || it.id] = it.quantity;
        }
        return map;
      }

      window.fetch = function () {
        var args = arguments;
        var url = args[0];

        // Capture BEFORE state
        if (isCartMutation(url) && window.kitAnalyticsMeta && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart) {
          before = snapshot(window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart);
          prevItems = window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart.items || [];
        }

        return originalFetch.apply(window, args).then(function (res) {
          if (!isCartMutation(url)) return res;

          setTimeout(function () {
            fetch('/cart.js')
              .then(function (r) {
                return r.json();
              })
              .then(function (cart) {
                handleCartDiff(cart, before, prevItems);
              });
          }, 0);

          return res;
        });
      };

      function isTrackableCartItem(item) {
        if (!item) return false;
        if (item.vendor === 'BLM FCB') return false;
        if (item.title === 'UCL' || item.title === 'LaLiga Winners') return false;
        return true;
      }

      function handleCartDiff(cart, before, prevItems) {
        if (!cart || !Array.isArray(cart.items)) return;

        // CRITICAL FIX: Update the global state BEFORE firing events.
        // This ensures that when IM.track runs, it calculates totals based on the NEW cart state (e.g., 5 items).
        if (window.kitAnalyticsMeta) {
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta.cart = cart;
        }
        IM.cart.refresh('mutation');

        var after = snapshot(cart);

        // 1️⃣ ADD & REDUCE quantity
        // 1️⃣ ADD & REDUCE quantity — resolver bundles antes de disparar eventos
        var bundlesSeen = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < cart.items.length; i++) {
          var item = cart.items[i];
          var key = item.key || item.id;
          var prevQty = before && before[key] ? before[key] : 0;
          var props = item.properties || {};
          var bundleId = props._bundle_id;

          // Si es un item de bundle secundario (Badge o Customization), saltarlo
          // El item base del bundle ya lo gestiona con los datos completos
          if (
            bundleId &&
            (item.vendor === 'BLM FCB' || item.product_type === 'Badge' || item.product_type === 'Customization')
          ) {
            continue;
          }

          if (item.quantity > prevQty) {
            if (isTrackableCartItem(item)) {
              // Si es el item base de un bundle, enriquecerlo con datos del bundle
              if (bundleId && !bundlesSeen[bundleId]) {
                bundlesSeen[bundleId] = true;
                // Buscar los items relacionados del bundle en el carrito actual
                var bundlePatch = null;
                var bundlePlayer = null;
                var bundlePatchPrice = 0;
                var bundlePlayerPrice = 0;
                cart.items.forEach(function (bi) {
                  var bp = bi.properties || {};
                  if (bp._bundle_id !== bundleId) return;
                  if (bi.product_type === 'Badge') {
                    bundlePatch = bi.title;
                    bundlePatchPrice = (bi.price || 0) / 100;
                  }
                  if (bp.name) {
                    bundlePlayer = bp.name;
                    bundlePlayerPrice = (bi.price || 0) / 100;
                  }
                });
                fireAddToCart(item, item.quantity - prevQty, {
                  patch: bundlePatch,
                  player: bundlePlayer,
                  price_patch: bundlePatchPrice,
                  price_player: bundlePlayerPrice,
                });
              } else if (!bundleId) {
                fireAddToCart(item, item.quantity - prevQty);
              }
            }
          }

          if (item.quantity < prevQty) {
            if (isTrackableCartItem(item)) {
              fireRemoveFromCart(item, prevQty - item.quantity, 'reduce');
            }
          }
        }

        // 2️⃣ FULL REMOVAL (item no longer exists)
        if (before) {
          for (var removedKey in before) {
            if (!after[removedKey]) {
              var removedItem = null;

              for (var j = 0; j < prevItems.length; j++) {
                var it = prevItems[j];
                if ((it.key || it.id) === removedKey) {
                  removedItem = it;
                  break;
                }
              }

              if (removedItem && isTrackableCartItem(removedItem)) {
                fireRemoveFromCart(removedItem, before[removedKey], 'remove');
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      function fireAddToCart(item, deltaQty, bundleData) {
        if (!deltaQty || deltaQty <= 0) return;

        var product = null;

        var isPdp = IM.getPageType() === 'product';
        var pdpId = null;

        try {
          pdpId = window.productBaseLiquid && window.productBaseLiquid.id ? String(window.productBaseLiquid.id) : null;
        } catch (e) {}

        var cartProductId = String(item.product_id || item.id);

        var location;
        if (isPdp && IM.PDP && IM.PDP.buildItem && pdpId && cartProductId === pdpId) {
          product = IM.PDP.buildItem(1);
          product.quantity = IM.notApply(deltaQty);
          location = 'direct';
        } else {
          product = IM.mapCartItemToIMItem(item, deltaQty);
          location = IM.getPageType() === 'cart' ? 'bag' : 'minibag';
        }

        product.item_list_type = IM.notApply('cart');
        if (bundleData) {
          product.patch = IM.notApply(bundleData.patch);
          product.player = IM.notApply(bundleData.player);
          product.price_patch = IM.notApply(bundleData.price_patch || null);
          product.price_player = IM.notApply(bundleData.price_player || null);
          if (bundleData.player || bundleData.patch) {
            product.personalized_item = 'yes';
          }
        }

        IM.track('add_to_cart', {
          events: ['scAdd', 'event174'],
          event_action: 'add_to_cart',
          event_location: location,
          ecommerce: {
            items: [product],
          },
        });
      }

      function fireRemoveFromCart(item, deltaQty, removalType) {
        if (!deltaQty || deltaQty <= 0) return;

        var product = IM.mapCartItemToIMItem(item, deltaQty);
        var isCartPage = IM.getPageType() === 'cart';
        var location = isCartPage ? 'bag' : 'minibag';
        // Bug fix: event176 = full removal (X button), event177 = quantity reduction (- button)
        var eventCode = removalType === 'reduce' ? 'event177' : 'event176';
        product.item_list_type = IM.notApply(location);

        IM.track('remove_from_cart', {
          events: ['scRemove', eventCode],
          event_action: 'remove_from_cart',
          event_location: location,
          ecommerce: {
            items: [product],
          },
        });
      }
    })();

    IM.selectCollection = (function () {
      if (window.__im_select_collection_init) return;
      window.__im_select_collection_init = true;

      function resolveLocation(el) {
        if (el.closest('header')) return 'header';
        if (el.closest('.banner')) return 'banner';
        if (el.closest('.fcb-poster-multicolumn__item')) return 'home_collection';
        return IM.getPageType();
      }

      function extractCollectionHandle(el) {
        var href = null;

        if (el.tagName === 'A') {
          href = el.getAttribute('href');
        }

        if (!href) {
          var onclick = el.getAttribute('onclick') || '';
          var match = onclick.match(/['"]\/collections\/([^'"]+)/);
          if (match) href = '/collections/' + match[1];
        }

        if (!href) return null;

        var m = href.match(/\/collections\/([^/?#]+)/);
        return m ? m[1] : null;
      }

      document.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function (e) {
          var target = e.target;
          if (!target || !target.closest) return;
          if (target.closest('product-card')) return;
          var el = target.closest("a[href*='/collections/'], [onclick*='/collections/']");
          if (!el) return;

          if (el.closest('header')) return;

          var handle = extractCollectionHandle(el);
          if (!handle) return;

          IM.track('select_collection', {
            events: ['select_collection', 'event169'],
            event_action: 'click_collection',
            event_location: IM.notApply(resolveLocation(el)),
            collection_name: IM.notApply(handle),
            ecommerce: {},
          });
        },
        true
      );
    })();
