    IM.oneMoreViewItemList = (function () {
      if (window.__im_one_more_view_init) return;
      window.__im_one_more_view_init = true;

      var fired = false;
      var watcher = null;

      function isVisible(el) {
        if (!el || !el.getBoundingClientRect) return false;
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        var vh = window.innerHeight || 0;
        var vw = window.innerWidth || 0;
        if (vh <= 0 || vw <= 0) return false;

        var w = Math.max(0, Math.min(r.right, vw) - Math.max(r.left, 0));
        var h = Math.max(0, Math.min(r.bottom, vh) - Math.max(r.top, 0));
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;

        return (w * h) / (r.width * r.height) >= 0.3;
      }

      function buildItems(location) {
        var items = [];
        var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('#one-more li.one-more__li');

        for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
          var li = nodes[i];
          if (getComputedStyle(li).display === 'none') continue;

          var script = li.querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='one-more__product']");
          if (!script) continue;

          try {
            var p = JSON.parse(script.textContent);
            items.push({
              item_id: IM.notApply(p.id),
              item_name: IM.notApply(p.title),
              price: IM.notApply(p.price),
              quantity: 1,
              item_list_type: IM.notApply(location),
              index: items.length + 1,
            });
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        return items;
      }

      function tryFire() {
        if (fired) return;

        var container = document.getElementById('one-more');
        if (!container) {
          return;
        }

        if (!isVisible(container)) {
          return;
        }

        var isCartPage = IM.getPageType() === 'cart';
        var location = isCartPage ? 'bag' : 'minibag';
        var eventCode = isCartPage ? 'event192' : 'event192';

        var items = buildItems(location);
        if (!items.length) {
          return;
        }

        fired = true;
        clearInterval(watcher);

        IM.track('view_item_list', {
          events: ['view_item_list', eventCode],
          event_action: 'view_item_list',
          event_location: location,
          ecommerce: { items: items },
        });
      }

      function startWatcher() {
        if (watcher) clearInterval(watcher);
        fired = false;

        watcher = setInterval(tryFire, 200);
      }

      document.addEventListener(
        'click',
        function (e) {
          if (
            e.target.closest('[data-testid="cart-drawer-trigger"]') ||
            e.target.closest("[href='/cart']") ||
            e.target.closest('[data-cart-open]')
          ) {
            startWatcher();
          }
        },
        true
      );

      if (IM.getPageType() === 'cart') {
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
          document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            startWatcher();
          });
        } else {
          startWatcher();
        }
      }
    })();
    IM.identityCapture = (function () {
      function capture(root) {
        try {
          var scope = root || document;
          var emailEl =
            scope.querySelector("input[type='email']") ||
            scope.querySelector("input[name*='mail']") ||
            scope.querySelector("input[name*='email']");
          var phoneEl =
            scope.querySelector("input[type='tel']") ||
            scope.querySelector("input[name*='tel']") ||
            scope.querySelector("input[name*='phone']") ||
            scope.querySelector("input[name*='whatsapp']");

          var email = emailEl ? IM.cleanEmail(emailEl.value) : '';
          var phone = phoneEl ? IM.cleanPhone(phoneEl.value) : '';
          if (!email && !phone) return;

          var stored = IM.getIdentity();
          var next = {
            email_sha256: stored.email_sha256 || null,
            phone_sha256: stored.phone_sha256 || null,
          };

          var promises = [];

          if (email) {
            promises.push(
              IM.sha256Hex(email).then(function (h) {
                if (h && h !== 'not apply') next.email_sha256 = h;
              })
            );
          }
          if (phone) {
            promises.push(
              IM.sha256Hex(phone).then(function (h) {
                if (h && h !== 'not apply') next.phone_sha256 = h;
              })
            );
          }

          Promise.all(promises).then(function () {
            IM.setIdentity(next);
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function init() {
        if (window.__im_identity_capture_init_v3) return;
        window.__im_identity_capture_init_v3 = true;

        document.addEventListener(
          'submit',
          function (e) {
            var f = e.target;
            if (!f || !f.querySelector) return;
            capture(f);
          },
          true
        );

        document.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;
            if (
              t.matches &&
              (t.matches("input[type='email']") ||
                t.matches("input[type='tel']") ||
                t.matches("input[name*='mail']") ||
                t.matches("input[name*='email']") ||
                t.matches("input[name*='tel']") ||
                t.matches("input[name*='phone']") ||
                t.matches("input[name*='whatsapp']"))
            ) {
              var f = t.closest('form');
              capture(f || document);
            }
          },
          true
        );
      }

      return { init: init };
    })();

    IM.login = (function () {
      if (window.__im_login_module_init) return;
      window.__im_login_module_init = true;

      var KEY_LOGIN_INTENT = '__im_login_intent';
      var KEY_SIGNUP_INTENT = '__im_signup_intent';

      function setFlag(key) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.setItem(key, '1');
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function hasFlag(key) {
        try {
          return sessionStorage.getItem(key) === '1';
        } catch (e) {}
        return false;
      }

      function clearFlag(key) {
        try {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function bindSignupPageIntent() {
        if (IM.getPageType() === 'sign_up') {
          setFlag(KEY_SIGNUP_INTENT);
        }
      }

      function bindLoginSubmit() {
        document.addEventListener(
          'submit',
          function (e) {
            var form = e.target;
            if (!form || !form.action) return;

            if (form.action.indexOf('/account/login') > -1) {
              setFlag(KEY_LOGIN_INTENT);
            }
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function bindClicks() {
        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var createAccount = t.closest("a[href='/account/register']");
            if (createAccount && IM.getPageType() === 'login') {
              IM.track('select_content', {
                events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
                event_action: 'click_creat_account',
                event_location: 'login',
                ecommerce: {},
              });
              return;
            }

            var loginLink = t.closest("a[href='/account/login']");
            if (loginLink && IM.getPageType() === 'sign_up') {
              IM.track('select_content', {
                events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
                event_action: 'click_login',
                event_location: 'create_account',
                ecommerce: {},
              });
            }
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function fireIfOnAccount() {
        // FIX: la comparacion exigia el path EXACTO "/account", pero el
        // sitio usa prefijos de idioma (/es/account, /en/account...) igual
        // que el resto de logica de la pagina (ver IM.buildContext /
        // IM.getPageType). Por eso login/sign_up nunca llegaban a
        // dispararse. Normalizamos el prefijo de idioma igual que ahi.
        var path = (window.location.pathname || '').replace(/^\/[a-z]{2}(\/|$)/, '/');

        if (path !== '/account' && path !== '/account/') return;

        if (hasFlag(KEY_SIGNUP_INTENT)) {
          IM.track('sign_up', {
            events: ['sign_up', 'event1'],
            event_action: 'create_account',
            event_location: 'create_account',
            ecommerce: {},
          });
          clearFlag(KEY_SIGNUP_INTENT);
        }

        if (hasFlag(KEY_LOGIN_INTENT)) {
          IM.track('login', {
            events: ['login', 'event163'],
            event_action: 'login',
            event_location: 'login',
            ecommerce: {},
          });
          clearFlag(KEY_LOGIN_INTENT);
        }
      }

      // FIX: Shopify Customer Accounts (login unificado en shopify.com,
      // fuera del storefront) hace que la deteccion antigua (interceptar el
      // submit de /account/login) nunca llegue a activarse - el login real
      // ni pasa por ese formulario. Detectamos el login comparando el
      // estado de sesion (logado/no logado) entre cargas de pagina: si en
      // esta MISMA sesion de navegador vimos antes al usuario sin logar y
      // ahora aparece logado, disparamos "login" una vez.
      var STATE_KEY = '__im_login_state';

      function checkLoginTransition() {
        try {
          var currentlyLogged = !!(
            window.kitAnalyticsMeta &&
            window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user &&
            window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user.id
          );
          var prevState = sessionStorage.getItem(STATE_KEY); // '1' | '0' | null

          // Solo disparamos si ya habiamos visto a este mismo navegador
          // como NO logado en esta sesion (prevState === '0') y ahora si
          // lo esta. Si prevState es null (1a pagina de la sesion), no
          // disparamos - no podemos saber si el login paso ahora o venia
          // de una sesion anterior.
          if (prevState === '0' && currentlyLogged) {
            IM.track('login', {
              events: ['login', 'event163'],
              event_action: 'login',
              event_location: 'login',
              ecommerce: {},
            });
          }

          sessionStorage.setItem(STATE_KEY, currentlyLogged ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function init() {
        bindSignupPageIntent();
        bindLoginSubmit();
        bindClicks();

        IM.waitFor(
          function () {
            return typeof IM.track === 'function';
          },
          { timeout: 5000, interval: 50 }
        ).then(function () {
          fireIfOnAccount();
          checkLoginTransition();
        });
      }

      return {
        init: init,
      };
    })();

    IM.footer = (function () {
      if (window.__im_footer_init) return;
      window.__im_footer_init = true;

      function getLinkText(a) {
        try {
          return a.textContent && a.textContent.trim() ? a.textContent.trim() : 'not apply';
        } catch (e) {}
        return 'not apply';
      }

      function bindFooterLinks() {
        // FIX: Adobe AppMeasurement (link tracking automatico de Adobe
        // Launch) vuelve a invocar este mismo handler tras completar su
        // propio beacon, duplicando el select_content para un unico click.
        // Mitigamos con el mismo patron de dedupe que ya usa select_item.
        var lastFooterKey = null;
        var lastFooterTime = 0;

        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var a = t.closest('a[href]');
            if (!a || !a.closest('footer')) return;

            var linkText = getLinkText(a);
            var dedupeKey = linkText + '|' + (a.getAttribute('href') || '');
            var now = Date.now();
            if (dedupeKey === lastFooterKey && now - lastFooterTime < 1000) return;
            lastFooterKey = dedupeKey;
            lastFooterTime = now;

            IM.track('select_content', {
              events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
              event_action: 'click_footer',
              event_location: 'footer',
              eventData: {
                footer_name: IM.notApply(linkText),
              },
              ecommerce: {},
            });
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function isNewsletterForm(form) {
        if (!form || !form.action) return false;
        if (form.id !== 'contact_form') return false;
        return true;
      }

      function bindNewsletterSubmit() {
        document.addEventListener(
          'submit',
          function (e) {
            var form = e.target;
            if (!isNewsletterForm(form)) return;

            IM.track('newsletter_ok', {
              events: ['newsletter_ok', 'event2'],
              event_action: 'newsletter_ok',
              event_location: 'Footer',
              ecommerce: { noCart: true },
            });
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function isContactForm(form) {
        if (!form || !form.action) return false;
        if (form.id !== 'contact_form') return false;
        // Diferenciamos del newsletter por la presencia de campo de mensaje
        var hasMessage = form.querySelector("textarea, input[name*='body'], input[name*='message']");
        return !!hasMessage;
      }

      function bindContactFormSubmit() {
        document.addEventListener(
          'submit',
          function (e) {
            var form = e.target;
            if (!isContactForm(form)) return;

            IM.track('contact_form', {
              events: ['contact_form', 'event3'],
              event_action: 'contact_form',
              event_location: 'contact',
              ecommerce: { noCart: true },
            });
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function init() {
        bindFooterLinks();
        bindNewsletterSubmit();
        bindContactFormSubmit();
      }

      return {
        init: init,
      };
    })();

    IM.PDP = (function () {
      var lastSize = null;
      var currentPatch = null;

      function getBreadcrumbCollection() {
        try {
          // Extract collection from breadcrumbs
          var crumbs = document.querySelectorAll('.fcb-breadcrumbs li a[href*="/collections/"]');
          if (crumbs && crumbs.length > 0) {
            var lastCrumb = crumbs[crumbs.length - 1];
            return lastCrumb.textContent ? lastCrumb.textContent.trim() : null;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        return null;
      }

      function getSelectedSize() {
        var el;
        el = document.querySelector('input.kit-size-radio:checked');
        if (el) return el.getAttribute('data-label') || el.value || null;

        el = document.querySelector("input[name='kit-size']:checked");
        if (el) return el.getAttribute('data-label') || el.value || null;

        el = document.querySelector("input[type='radio'][name='SIZE']:checked");
        if (el) return el.value || null;

        el = document.querySelector("select[name='id']");
        if (el && el.selectedOptions && el.selectedOptions.length) {
          var txt = el.selectedOptions[0].textContent || '';
          return txt.split('-')[0].trim() || null;
        }

        if (window.productBaseLiquid?.variants) {
          var selectedId =
            document.querySelector("input[name='id']")?.value || document.querySelector("select[name='id']")?.value;
          var v = window.productBaseLiquid.variants.find(function (v) {
            return String(v.id) === String(selectedId);
          });
          if (v?.public_title) return v.public_title;
        }
        return null;
      }

      function getPrices() {
        var liquid = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
        var base = liquid.price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.price) / 100 : 0;
        var patch = 0;
        var patchEl = document.querySelector("input[name='competition']:checked[data-badge-price]");
        if (patchEl) patch = IM.toNumber(patchEl.getAttribute('data-badge-price')) / 100;
        var player = 0;
        var playerEl = document.querySelector('.kit-customization-price [data-raw-price]');
        var playerNameEl = document.querySelector(
          '.kit-player-name input, .kit-player-number input, [data-player-name]'
        );
        var hasPlayerCustomization =
          playerNameEl && (playerNameEl.value || playerNameEl.getAttribute('data-player-name'));
        if (playerEl && hasPlayerCustomization) player = IM.toNumber(playerEl.getAttribute('data-raw-price')) / 100;

        return { base: base, patch: patch, player: player, total: base + patch + player };
      }

      function extractLabel(v) {
        if (!v) return IM.notApply(null);
        if (typeof v === 'string') return v;
        if (typeof v === 'object' && v.label) return v.label;
        return IM.notApply(null);
      }

      function getState() {
        var meta = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
        var analytics = meta.metafields?.analytics || {};
        var prices = getPrices();
        var domPatch = document.querySelector("input[name='competition']:checked");
        var resolvedPatch = currentPatch !== null ? currentPatch : domPatch ? domPatch.value : null;
        return {
          meta: meta,
          analytics: analytics,
          prices: prices,
          size: getSelectedSize(),
          patch: resolvedPatch,
          player: window.productBaseObject?.customization?.playerReference || null,
          personalized: window.productBaseObject?.customization ? 'yes' : 'no',
        };
      }

      function buildItem(index) {
        var s = getState();
        var pid = s.meta.id;
        var navigationCollection = getBreadcrumbCollection();

        if (!navigationCollection) {
          try {
            var ref = document.referrer || '';
            var refMatch = ref.match(/\/collections\/([^/?#]+)/);
            if (refMatch) {
              var collHandle = refMatch[1];
              var collMap = IM.safeJsonParse(sessionStorage.getItem('__im_prod_coll_map')) || {};
              navigationCollection = collMap[String(pid)] || collHandle;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        var collectionName =
          (s.meta.metafields && s.meta.metafields.info && s.meta.metafields.info.subtitle) || navigationCollection;

        if (pid && collectionName) {
          IM.saveProductCollectionContext(pid, collectionName);
        }

        return {
          item_sku: IM.notApply(s.meta.variants?.[0]?.sku ? String(s.meta.variants[0].sku) : null),
          item_id: IM.notApply(pid ? String(pid) : null),
          item_name: IM.notApply(
            (s.meta.metafields && s.meta.metafields.custom && s.meta.metafields.custom.title_en) ||
              s.meta.title ||
              s.meta.handle
          ),
          price: IM.notApply(s.prices.total),
          original_price: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var liquid = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
              var compareAt = liquid.compare_at_price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.compare_at_price) / 100 : 0;
              var price = liquid.price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.price) / 100 : 0;
              return compareAt > price ? compareAt : price;
            })()
          ),
          quantity: 1,
          item_size: IM.notApply(s.size),
          genre: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var g = IM.tagsToGenre(s.meta && s.meta.tags ? s.meta.tags : []);
              if (g && pid) IM.saveProductGenre(pid, g);
              return g;
            })()
          ),
          discount_percentage: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var liquid = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
              var price = liquid.price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.price) / 100 : 0;
              var compareAt = liquid.compare_at_price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.compare_at_price) / 100 : 0;
              if (compareAt > price && compareAt > 0) return Math.round(((compareAt - price) / compareAt) * 100);
              return 0;
            })()
          ),
          discount_applied: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var liquid = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
              var price = liquid.price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.price) / 100 : 0;
              var compareAt = liquid.compare_at_price ? IM.toNumber(liquid.compare_at_price) / 100 : 0;
              if (compareAt > price && compareAt > 0) return IM.round2(compareAt - price);
              return 0;
            })()
          ),
          item_brand: IM.notApply(
            (s.analytics.brand && (s.analytics.brand.value || s.analytics.brand)) || s.meta.vendor?.toLowerCase()
          ),
          item_affiliate_name: IM.notApply(
            (s.analytics.brand && (s.analytics.brand.value || s.analytics.brand)) || s.meta.vendor?.toLowerCase()
          ),
          item_list_type: 'direct',
          item_list_name: IM.notApply(navigationCollection),
          collection_name: IM.notApply(collectionName),
          index: index || 1,
          patch: IM.notApply(s.patch),
          price_patch: IM.notApply(s.prices.patch),
          price_player: IM.notApply(s.prices.player),
          player: IM.notApply(s.player),
          personalized_item: s.personalized,
          discount_type: IM.notApply(null),
          is_kit: IM.notApply(IM.isKitProductType(s.meta.type || s.meta.product_type) ? 'Yes' : 'No'),
        };
      }

      function buildItems() {
        return [buildItem(1)];
      }

      function bindSizeChange() {
        document.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function (e) {
            if (IM.getPageType() !== 'product') return;

            // Track patch changes reactively (Bug 7)
            if (e.target && e.target.matches && e.target.matches("input[name='competition']")) {
              currentPatch = e.target.value || null;
              IM.log('[IM.PDP] Patch updated:', currentPatch);
            }

            var size = getSelectedSize();
            if (!size || size === lastSize) return;
            lastSize = size;
            IM.track('select_size', {
              events: ['select_size', 'event158'],
              event_action: 'select_size',
              size: IM.notApply(size),
              event_location: IM.notApply(document.title),
              eventData: { size: IM.notApply(size) },
              ecommerce: { items: buildItems() },
            });
          },
          true
        );
      }

      function init() {
        bindSizeChange();
      }

      return { init: init, getState: getState, buildItem: buildItem, buildItems: buildItems };
    })();

    IM.customer = (function () {
      try {
        if (
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta &&
          window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user &&
          typeof window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user === 'object'
        ) {
          return window.kitAnalyticsMeta.user;
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      try {
        if (window.fcbDL && window.fcbDL.user && typeof window.fcbDL.user === 'object') {
          return window.fcbDL.user;
        }
      } catch (e2) {}

      return null;
    })();

    IM.cart = (function () {
      var KEY = '__im_cart_cache_v2';
      var cache = { quantity: 0, value: 0, value_raw: 0, currency: 'not apply', id: 'not apply', updatedAt: 0 };
      var inFlight = false;

      function load() {
        try {
          var raw = window.localStorage ? localStorage.getItem(KEY) : null;
          if (!raw) return;
          var p = IM.safeJsonParse(raw);
          if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return;
          if (typeof p.quantity === 'number') cache.quantity = p.quantity;
          if (typeof p.value === 'number') cache.value = p.value;
          if (typeof p.value_raw === 'number') cache.value_raw = p.value_raw;
          if (typeof p.currency === 'string') cache.currency = p.currency;
          if (typeof p.id === 'string') cache.id = p.id;
          if (typeof p.updatedAt === 'number') cache.updatedAt = p.updatedAt;
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function save() {
        try {
          if (!window.localStorage) return;
          localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(cache));
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      function normalizeFromFcbLike(obj) {
        var out = {
          quantity: 0,
          value_raw: 0,
          value: 0,
          currency: IM.getActiveCurrency(),
          id: 'not apply',
          updatedAt: Date.now(),
        };
        try {
          if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return out;
          if (obj.cart && typeof obj.cart === 'object') obj = obj.cart;

          if (typeof obj.size === 'number') out.quantity = obj.size;
          else if (typeof obj.item_count === 'number') out.quantity = obj.item_count;

          if (typeof obj.value === 'number') out.value_raw = obj.value;
          else if (typeof obj.total_price === 'number') out.value_raw = obj.total_price;

          out.value = IM.round2(out.value_raw / 100);

          if (typeof obj.currency === 'string' && obj.currency) out.currency = String(obj.currency).toLowerCase();
          out.id = typeof obj.id === 'string' && obj.id ? obj.id : 'not apply';
        } catch (e) {}
        return out;
      }

      function readFromGlobals() {
        try {
          if (window.fcbDL && typeof window.fcbDL === 'object') {
            var n1 = normalizeFromFcbLike(window.fcbDL);
            if (n1.quantity || n1.value_raw) return n1;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
          if (window.kitAnalyticsMeta && typeof window.kitAnalyticsMeta === 'object') {
            var n2 = normalizeFromFcbLike(window.kitAnalyticsMeta);
            if (n2.quantity || n2.value_raw) return n2;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        return null;
      }

      function normalizeFromCartJs(cart) {
        var out = {
          quantity: 0,
          value_raw: 0,
          value: 0,
          currency: IM.getActiveCurrency(),
          id: 'not apply',
          updatedAt: Date.now(),
        };
        try {
          if (!cart || typeof cart !== 'object') return out;
          out.quantity = typeof cart.item_count === 'number' ? cart.item_count : 0;
          out.value_raw = typeof cart.total_price === 'number' ? cart.total_price : 0;
          out.value = IM.round2(out.value_raw / 100);
          if (typeof cart.currency === 'string' && cart.currency) out.currency = String(cart.currency).toLowerCase();
          out.id =
            typeof cart.token === 'string' && cart.token
              ? cart.token
              : typeof cart.id === 'string'
              ? cart.id
              : 'not apply';
        } catch (e) {}
        return out;
      }

      function refresh(reason) {
        if (inFlight) return;
        inFlight = true;

        try {
          var g = readFromGlobals();
          if (g) {
            cache.quantity = g.quantity;
            cache.value_raw = g.value_raw;
            cache.value = g.value;
            cache.currency = g.currency || IM.getActiveCurrency();
            cache.id = g.id || 'not apply';
            cache.updatedAt = Date.now();
            save();
            inFlight = false;
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        try {
          fetch('/cart.js', { credentials: 'same-origin' })
            .then(function (r) {
              return r.json();
            })
            .then(function (cart) {
              var n = normalizeFromCartJs(cart);
              cache.quantity = n.quantity;
              cache.value_raw = n.value_raw;
              cache.value = n.value;
              cache.currency = n.currency || IM.getActiveCurrency();
              cache.id = n.id || 'not apply';
              cache.updatedAt = Date.now();
              save();
            })
            .catch(function () {})
            .finally(function () {
              inFlight = false;
            });
        } catch (e) {
          inFlight = false;
        }
      }

      function getSnapshot() {
        var now = Date.now();
        var maxStale = 2 * 60 * 1000;

        var g = readFromGlobals();
        if (g) {
          cache.quantity = g.quantity;
          cache.value_raw = g.value_raw;
          cache.value = g.value;
          cache.currency = g.currency || IM.getActiveCurrency();
          cache.id = g.id || 'not apply';
          cache.updatedAt = Date.now();
          save();
        } else if (!cache.updatedAt || now - cache.updatedAt > maxStale) {
          refresh('stale');
        }

        return {
          cart_id: cache.id || 'not apply',
          cart_quantity: typeof cache.quantity === 'number' ? cache.quantity : 0,
          cart_value: typeof cache.value === 'number' ? cache.value : 0,
          cart_value_raw: typeof cache.value_raw === 'number' ? cache.value_raw : 0,
          currency: typeof cache.currency === 'string' ? cache.currency : IM.getActiveCurrency(),
        };
      }

      load();
      refresh('init');

      window.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        function () {
          refresh('focus');
        },
        true
      );
      document.addEventListener(
        'visibilitychange',
        function () {
          if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') refresh('visible');
        },
        true
      );

      setInterval(function () {
        refresh('interval');
      }, 30000);

      return { getSnapshot: getSnapshot, refresh: refresh };
    })();

    IM.header = (function () {
      var lastSearchSig = '';
      var lastSearchTerm = null;

      function trackSearchExecution(term, trigger) {
        if (!term) return;
        lastSearchTerm = term;

        IM.track('search', {
          events: ['Buscador', 'event181'],
          event_action: 'search',
          event_location: 'header',
          search_term: IM.notApply(term),
          eventData: {
            search_term: IM.notApply(term),
            // ELIMINADO: trigger (no existe en la guía)
          },
          ecommerce: {},
        });
      }

      function isImageClick(target, anchor) {
        if (!target) return false;
        if (target.tagName === 'IMG') return true;
        if (target.closest && target.closest('img')) return true;
        if (anchor && anchor.querySelector && anchor.querySelector('img')) return anchor.contains(target);
        return false;
      }

      function getMenuLevels(a) {
        var level1 = null;
        var level2 = null;

        try {
          // Horizon drawer: active first-level nav item
          var activeNav = document.querySelector('.drawer-nav-item.is-active[data-target]');
          if (activeNav) {
            level1 = activeNav.textContent ? activeNav.textContent.trim() : null;
          }

          // Clicked link inside a drawer link item
          var drawerLink = a.closest('.drawer-link-item');
          if (drawerLink) {
            level2 = a.textContent ? a.textContent.trim() : null;
          }

          // Fallback: read data-target attribute of parent nav
          if (!level1) {
            var parentNav = a.closest('[data-target]');
            if (parentNav) level1 = parentNav.getAttribute('data-target') || null;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        return {
          menu_level1: IM.notApply(level1),
          menu_level2: IM.notApply(level2),
          menu_level3: IM.notApply(null),
          full_menu: IM.notApply([level1, level2].filter(Boolean).join(':')),
        };
      }

      function getItemFromProductImpression(target) {
        var card = target.closest('product-card');
        if (!card) return null;

        var script = card.querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='product-impression-']");
        if (!script) return null;

        var product = IM.safeJsonParse(script.textContent);
        if (!product) return null;

        var index = null;
        try {
          var li = card.closest('li');
          if (li && li.parentNode) index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(li.parentNode.children, li) + 1;
        } catch (e) {}

        return { product: product, index: index };
      }

      function mapProductToBLMItem(params) {
        var p = params.product || {};
        var menu = params.menu || {};

        var originalPrice = p.compare_at_price && p.compare_at_price > 0 ? p.compare_at_price : p.price;
        var discountPercentage =
          originalPrice && originalPrice > p.price ? Math.round(((originalPrice - p.price) / originalPrice) * 100) : 0;

        return {
          item_sku: IM.notApply(p.sku ? String(p.sku) : null),
          item_id: IM.notApply(p.product_id || p.id ? String(p.product_id || p.id) : null),
          item_name: IM.notApply(p.title),
          price: IM.notApply(p.price),
          genre: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var fromInfoGender = Array.isArray(p.info_gender) && p.info_gender.length ? p.info_gender[0] : null;
              var g = IM.tagsToGenre(p.tags) || fromInfoGender || IM.getProductGenre(p.product_id || p.id);
              var pid = p.product_id || p.id;
              if (g && pid) IM.saveProductGenre(pid, g);
              return g;
            })()
          ),
          quantity: 1,
          item_size: IM.notApply(null),
          original_price: IM.notApply(originalPrice),
          discount_percentage: IM.notApply(discountPercentage),
          discount_applied: IM.notApply(discountPercentage > 0 ? 1 : 0),
          item_brand: IM.notApply(p.vendor),
          item_affiliate_name: IM.notApply(p.vendor),
          item_list_type: IM.notApply(params.item_list_type),
          item_list_name: IM.notApply(params.item_list_type),
          index: IM.notApply(params.index),
          patch: IM.notApply(p.patch || null),
          price_patch: IM.notApply(null),
          player: IM.notApply(null),
          price_player: IM.notApply(null),
          personalized_item: IM.notApply('no'),
          discount_type: IM.notApply(null),
          is_kit: IM.notApply(IM.isKitProductType(p.type || p.product_type) ? 'Yes' : 'No'),
        };
      }

      function trackPredictiveImpression(container) {
        var cards = container.querySelectorAll('product-card');
        if (!cards.length) return;

        var items = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          var s = cards[i].querySelector("script[type='application/json']");
          if (!s) continue;

          var p = IM.safeJsonParse(s.textContent);
          if (!p) continue;

          items.push(
            mapProductToBLMItem({
              product: p,
              menu: {},
              item_list_type: 'internal_search',
              index: i + 1,
            })
          );
        }

        var sig = items
          .map(function (i) {
            return i.item_id;
          })
          .join('|');
        if (!sig || sig === lastSearchSig) return;
        lastSearchSig = sig;

        IM.track('view_item_list', {
          events: ['view_item_list', 'event192'],
          event_action: 'view_item_list',
          event_location: 'search',
          ecommerce: { items: items },
        });
      }

      function init() {
        if (window.__im_header_init_final) return;
        window.__im_header_init_final = true;

        // CHECKOUT BUTTON IN HEADER/MINIBAG
        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var checkoutBtn = t.closest("[name='checkout']");
            if (!checkoutBtn) return;
            if (IM.shouldSkipDuplicateBeginCheckout()) return;

            var cart = IM.cart.getSnapshot();

            IM.track('begin_checkout', {
              events: ['begin_checkout', 'event197'],
              event_action: 'begin_checkout',
              event_location: IM.getPageType() === 'cart' ? 'bag' : 'minibag',
              ecommerce: {
                cart_quantity: cart.cart_quantity,
                cart_value: cart.cart_value,
                items: IM.buildCartItemsFromMeta(),
              },
            });
          },
          true
        );

        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var trigger = t.closest('[data-testid="cart-drawer-trigger"]');
            if (!trigger) return;

            var cartItems = IM.buildCartItemsFromMeta();

            IM.track('open_minibag', {
              events: ['event175'],
              event_action: 'open',
              event_location: 'header',
              ecommerce: {
                items: cartItems,
              },
            });
          },
          true
        );

        // CLICK SEARCH ICON
        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var search = t.closest('search-button a[aria-label="Go to search"]');
            if (!search) return;

            IM.track('select_content', {
              events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
              event_action: 'click_search_icon',
              event_location: 'header',
              // ELIMINADO: element_text, element_type (no existen en guía)
              // ELIMINADO: event_info
              ecommerce: {},
            });
            IM.lists.forceSearchList();
          },
          true
        );

        // ENTER KEY IN SEARCH
        document.addEventListener(
          'keydown',
          function (e) {
            if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
            if (!e.target || !e.target.matches || !e.target.matches('input[name="q"]')) return;
            trackSearchExecution(e.target.value, 'enter');
          },
          true
        );

        // CLICK MENU ITEMS (CATEGORIES/BANNERS)
        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            if (!t || !t.closest) return;

            var a = t.closest('a[href]');
            if (!a || !a.closest('header') || a.closest('.predictive-search')) return;
            if (a.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Go to search') return;
            if (a.closest('.fcb-cart-item')) return;
            if (a.getAttribute('href') === '/cart') return;

            var levels = getMenuLevels(a);
            var data = getItemFromProductImpression(t);
            var items = [];

            if (data) {
              items.push(
                mapProductToBLMItem({
                  product: data.product,
                  index: data.index,
                  menu: levels,
                  item_list_type: 'header',
                })
              );
            }

            IM.track('select_content', {
              events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
              event_action: isImageClick(t, a) ? 'click_banner' : 'click_category',
              event_location: 'header',
              eventData: {
                // ELIMINADO: link_url (no existe en guía)
                menu_level1: levels.menu_level1,
                menu_level2: levels.menu_level2,
                menu_level3: levels.menu_level3,
                full_menu: levels.full_menu,
                widget_name: isImageClick(t, a) ? IM.notApply(levels.full_menu) : IM.notApply(null),
              },
              ecommerce: { items: items },
            });
          },
          true
        );

        document.addEventListener('predictive:results', function (e) {
          var container = e.detail && e.detail.container;
          if (!container) return;
          trackPredictiveImpression(container);
        });
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        trackPredictiveImpression: trackPredictiveImpression,
      };
    })();

    IM.lists = (function () {
      var io = null;
      var visible = {};
      var firedRowSignatures = {};
      var refreshTimer = null;
      var lastSigGlobal = '';
      var firedHomeCollections = {};

      var searchForcedFired = false;

      function debounce(fn, wait) {
        var t = null;
        return function () {
          if (t) clearTimeout(t);
          t = setTimeout(fn, wait);
        };
      }

      function isHeaderContext(node) {
        if (!node || !node.closest) return false;

        if (node.closest('.predictive-search')) return false;

        return !!node.closest('header');
      }
      function groupCardsByRow(cards) {
        var rows = [];
        var tolerance = 5;

        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          var card = cards[i];
          var top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top;

          var rowFound = false;

          for (var r = 0; r < rows.length; r++) {
            if (Math.abs(rows[r].top - top) <= tolerance) {
              rows[r].cards.push(card);
              rowFound = true;
              break;
            }
          }

          if (!rowFound) {
            rows.push({
              top: top,
              cards: [card],
            });
          }
        }

        return rows;
      }

      function resolveListContext(node, forced) {
        if (forced) return 'search';
        if (!node || !node.closest) {
          var pt = IM.getPageType();
          if (pt === 'category') {
            try {
              return window.kitAnalyticsMeta.collection.title || pt;
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          return pt;
        }
        if (node.closest('.complete-look-section') || node.closest('product-recommendations'))
          return 'related_products';
        if (node.closest('.predictive-search')) return 'search';
        var pageType = IM.getPageType();
        if (pageType === 'category') {
          try {
            return window.kitAnalyticsMeta.collection.title || pageType;
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        return pageType;
      }
      function getHomeCollectionKey(card) {
        var grid = card.closest("ul[id^='product-grid-'], .complete-look-grid");
        if (grid && grid.id) return grid.id;
        if (card.closest('.complete-look-grid')) return 'complete-look-static'; // Fallback for the new section
        // Handle resource-list carousel (home page slideshow)
        var resourceCarousel = card.closest('.resource-list__carousel');
        if (resourceCarousel) {
          var track = resourceCarousel.querySelector('slideshow-slides[id]');
          return track && track.id ? 'resource-list-' + track.id : 'resource-list-carousel';
        }
        return null;
      }

      function parseCardJson(card) {
        if (!card || !card.querySelector) return null;
        var s = card.querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='product-impression']");
        if (!s) return null;
        return IM.safeJsonParse(s.textContent || '') || null;
      }

      function buildItemFromCard(card, listName, index) {
        var pd = parseCardJson(card) || {};

        var sku = card.getAttribute('data-reference') || pd.sku || null;
        var id = pd.product_id || pd.id || null;
        var name = pd.title || null;

        var price = typeof pd.price === 'number' ? pd.price : null;
        var compareAt = typeof pd.compare_at_price === 'number' ? pd.compare_at_price : null;

        var original_price = compareAt && compareAt > price ? compareAt : price;
        var hasDiscount = original_price && price && original_price > price;
        var discount_percentage = hasDiscount ? Math.round(((original_price - price) / original_price) * 100) : 0;
        var discount_applied = hasDiscount ? IM.round2(original_price - price) : 0;

        var brand = typeof pd.vendor === 'string' ? pd.vendor.toLowerCase() : null;

        return {
          item_sku: IM.notApply(sku ? String(sku) : null),
          item_id: IM.notApply(id != null ? String(id) : null),
          item_name: IM.notApply(name || pd.handle),
          price: IM.notApply(price),
          genre: IM.notApply(
            (function () {
              var g = IM.tagsToGenre(pd.tags) || IM.getProductGenre(id);
              if (g && id) IM.saveProductGenre(id, g);
              return g;
            })()
          ),
          quantity: IM.notApply(1),
          item_size: IM.notApply(null),
          original_price: IM.notApply(original_price),
          discount_percentage: IM.notApply(discount_percentage),
          discount_applied: IM.notApply(discount_applied),
          item_brand: IM.notApply(brand),
          item_affiliate_name: IM.notApply(brand),
          full_menu: IM.notApply(null),
          item_list_type: IM.notApply(
            card.closest('.complete-look-section') || card.closest('product-recommendations')
              ? 'related_products'
              : listName
          ),
          item_list_name: IM.notApply(
            card.closest('.complete-look-section') || card.closest('product-recommendations')
              ? 'You May Also Like'
              : listName === 'search'
              ? IM.parseQuery(window.location.search).q || 'search'
              : listName
          ),
          collection_name: IM.notApply(
            window.kitAnalyticsMeta && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.collection && window.kitAnalyticsMeta.collection.title
              ? window.kitAnalyticsMeta.collection.title
              : IM.getProductCollectionContext(id)
          ),
          index: IM.notApply(index),
          patch: IM.notApply(null),
          price_patch: IM.notApply(null),
          player: IM.notApply(null),
          price_player: IM.notApply(null),
          personalized_item: IM.notApply(null),
          discount_type: IM.notApply(null),
          is_kit: IM.notApply(IM.isKitProductType(pd.type || pd.product_type) ? 'Yes' : 'No'),
        };
      }

      function signature(items) {
        var s = '';
        for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
          s += String(items[i].item_id || '') + '|';
        }
        return s;
      }

      function isVisible(el) {
        if (!el || !el.getBoundingClientRect) return false;
        var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        var vh = window.innerHeight || 0;
        var vw = window.innerWidth || 0;
        if (vh <= 0 || vw <= 0) return false;
        var w = Math.max(0, Math.min(r.right, vw) - Math.max(r.left, 0));
        var h = Math.max(0, Math.min(r.bottom, vh) - Math.max(r.top, 0));
        if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return false;
        return (w * h) / (r.width * r.height) >= 0.2;
      }
      function trackProductCardClick(e) {
        var target = e.target;
        if (!target || !target.closest) return;

        var card = target.closest('product-card');
        if (!card) return;

        if (!card.querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='product-impression']")) return;

        var listContext = 'not apply';

        if (card.closest('header')) listContext = 'header';
        else listContext = IM.getPageType();

        var index = null;
        try {
          var li = card.closest('li');
          if (li && li.parentNode) index = Array.prototype.indexOf.call(li.parentNode.children, li) + 1;
        } catch (e2) {}

        var item = buildItemFromCard(card, listContext, index || 1);

        var banner = target.closest('[data-collection-handle]');
        if (banner) {
          var collectionName = banner.getAttribute('data-collection-handle');

          IM.track('select_content', {
            events: ['select_content', 'event99'],
            event_action: 'click_collection',
            event_location: IM.notApply(IM.getPageType()),
            collection_name: IM.notApply(collectionName),
            ecommerce: {},
          });

          return;
        }
      }

      function collectVisibleItems(forced) {
        var cards = document.querySelectorAll('product-card');
        if (!cards.length) return;

        var listContext = null;
        var collectionsMap = {};
        var visibleCards = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          var card = cards[i];
          if (isHeaderContext(card)) continue;
          if (!isVisible(card)) continue;

          if (!listContext) listContext = resolveListContext(card, forced);

          if (listContext === 'home') {
            var collectionKey = getHomeCollectionKey(card);
            if (!collectionKey) continue;
            if (!collectionsMap[collectionKey]) collectionsMap[collectionKey] = [];
            collectionsMap[collectionKey].push(card);
          } else {
            visibleCards.push(card);
          }
        }

        if (listContext !== 'home') {
          if (!visibleCards.length) return;

          var rows = [];
          var tolerance = 5;

          for (var r = 0; r < visibleCards.length; r++) {
            var c = visibleCards[r];
            var top = c.getBoundingClientRect().top;
            var placed = false;

            for (var x = 0; x < rows.length; x++) {
              if (Math.abs(rows[x].top - top) <= tolerance) {
                rows[x].cards.push(c);
                placed = true;
                break;
              }
            }

            if (!placed) {
              rows.push({ top: top, cards: [c] });
            }
          }

          for (var y = 0; y < rows.length; y++) {
            var rowCards = rows[y].cards;
            var items = [];

            for (var z = 0; z < rowCards.length; z++) {
              items.push(buildItemFromCard(rowCards[z], listContext, z + 1));
            }

            if (!items.length) continue;

            var rowSignature = listContext + '|' + signature(items);

            if (!forced && firedRowSignatures[rowSignature]) continue;
            firedRowSignatures[rowSignature] = true;

            var isPdp = listContext === 'product';

            IM.track('view_item_list', {
              events: ['view_item_list', isPdp ? 'event152' : 'event192'],
              event_action: 'view_item_list',
              event_location: IM.notApply(isPdp ? document.title : listContext),
              ecommerce: { items: items, value: null },
            });
          }

          return;
        }

        for (var key in collectionsMap) {
          if (firedHomeCollections[key]) continue;

          var cardsInCollection = collectionsMap[key];
          var itemsInCollection = [];

          for (var k = 0; k < cardsInCollection.length; k++) {
            itemsInCollection.push(buildItemFromCard(cardsInCollection[k], 'home', k + 1));
          }

          if (!itemsInCollection.length) continue;

          firedHomeCollections[key] = true;

          IM.track('view_item_list', {
            events: ['view_item_list', 'event192'],
            event_action: 'view_item_list',
            event_location: 'home',
            ecommerce: { items: itemsInCollection, value: null },
          });
        }
      }

      function forceSearchList() {
        if (searchForcedFired) {
          return;
        }

        searchForcedFired = true;

        setTimeout(function () {
          collectVisibleItems(true);
        }, 50);
      }

      function observeCard(card) {
        if (!card || !io) return;
        if (isHeaderContext(card)) return;
        io.observe(card);
      }

      function scanAndObserve() {
        var cards = document.querySelectorAll('product-card');
        for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
          if (isHeaderContext(cards[i])) continue;
          if (!cards[i].querySelector("script[type='application/json'][id^='product-impression']")) continue;
          observeCard(cards[i]);
        }
      }

      function init() {
        if (window.__im_lists_init_final) return;
        window.__im_lists_init_final = true;

        if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;

        io = new IntersectionObserver(
          function () {
            if (refreshTimer) clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
            refreshTimer = setTimeout(function () {
              collectVisibleItems(false);
            }, 120);
          },
          { threshold: [0.5] }
        );

        scanAndObserve();

        var scanDebounced = debounce(scanAndObserve, 200);

        try {
          var mo = new MutationObserver(function () {
            scanDebounced();
          });
          mo.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        } catch (e) {}

        if (document.readyState === 'complete')
          setTimeout(function () {
            collectVisibleItems(false);
          }, 200);
        else
          window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
              collectVisibleItems(false);
            }, 200);
          });
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        forceSearchList: forceSearchList,
        buildItemFromCard: buildItemFromCard,
      };
    })();

    IM.phone = (function () {
      function init() {
        if (window.__im_phone_tracking_init_v3) return;
        window.__im_phone_tracking_init_v3 = true;

        document.addEventListener(
          'click',
          function (e) {
            var t = e.target;
            var a = t && t.closest ? t.closest("a[href^='tel:']") : null;
            if (!a) return;

            var href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
            var n = href.replace(/^tel:/i, '');
            n = IM.cleanPhone(n);

            // Use cta_name if appropriate, otherwise just don't send cta_number
            IM.track('phone_cta_click', {
              event_action: 'click_tel',
              // ELIMINADO: event_info
              // ELIMINADO: eventData: { cta_number: ... } - No existe en la guía
              cta_name: IM.notApply(n), // Map number to cta_name (evar32) if needed
              ecommerce: {},
            });
          },
          true
        );
      }

      return { init: init };
    })();

    IM.page = (function () {
      function firePageView() {
        IM.track('page_view', {
          events: ['page_view', 'event4'],
          event_action: 'load',
          ecommerce: { items: [], value: null },
        });
      }

      function trackPageView() {
        if ((window.location.pathname || '').indexOf('/search') > -1) return;
        firePageView();
      }

      function trackViewItemIfPdp() {
        var context = IM.buildContext();
        if (context.page_type !== 'product') return;

        var liquid = window.productBaseLiquid || {};
        var firstVariant = Array.isArray(liquid.variants) && liquid.variants.length ? liquid.variants[0] : {};
        var sku = firstVariant && firstVariant.sku ? firstVariant.sku : null;

        var id = liquid && liquid.id ? liquid.id : null;
        var name = liquid && liquid.handle ? liquid.handle : liquid.title || document.title || null;

        var price = 0;
        try {
          if (typeof liquid.price !== 'undefined') price = IM.toNumber(liquid.price) / 100;
        } catch (e) {}

        var brandRaw = liquid && liquid.vendor ? liquid.vendor : '';
        var brand = typeof brandRaw === 'string' ? brandRaw.toLowerCase() : brandRaw;

        var item = {
          item_sku: IM.notApply(sku),
          item_id: IM.notApply(id != null ? String(id) : null),
          item_name: IM.notApply(name),
          price: IM.notApply(IM.round2(price)),
          genre: IM.notApply(null),
          quantity: IM.notApply(1),
          item_size: IM.notApply(null),
          original_price: IM.notApply(IM.round2(price)),
          discount_percentage: IM.notApply(0),
          discount_applied: IM.notApply(0),
          item_brand: IM.notApply(brand),
          item_affiliate_name: IM.notApply(brand),
          menu_level1: IM.notApply(null),
          menu_level2: IM.notApply(null),
          menu_level3: IM.notApply(null),
          full_menu: IM.notApply(null),
          item_list_type: IM.notApply('direct'),
          index: IM.notApply(1),
          patch: IM.notApply(null),
          personalized_item: IM.notApply(null),
        };

        IM.track('view_item', {
          events: ['prodView', 'event206'],
          event_action: 'view_item',
          event_location: IM.notApply(document.title),
          ecommerce: {
            items: IM.PDP.buildItems(),
            value: IM.PDP.getState().prices.total,
          },
        });
      }

      function init() {
        var pageType = IM.getPageType();
        var lastReading = null;
        var startedAt = Date.now();
        IM.waitFor(
          function () {
            if (Date.now() - startedAt < 700) return false;
            var c = IM.getConsentAnalytics();
            if (typeof c !== 'boolean') return false;
            if (lastReading === null) {
              lastReading = c;
              return false;
            }
            return c === lastReading;
          },
          { timeout: 3000, interval: 150 }
        ).then(function () {
          var waitTargets = function () {
            if (pageType !== 'product') return true;
            return !!(window.productBaseLiquid || window.productBaseObject);
          };

          IM.waitFor(waitTargets, { timeout: 6000, interval: 50 }).then(function () {
            trackPageView();
            if (pageType === 'category') trackViewCategory();
            if (pageType === 'product') trackViewItemIfPdp();
            // Resolve the gate — all queued async view events (view_item_list, etc.) can now fire
            _resolvePageViewDone();
          });
        });
      }
      function trackViewCategory() {
        var context = IM.buildContext();
        if (context.page_type !== 'category') return;

        var categoryName = null;

        try {
          categoryName = document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent?.trim() || document.title;
        } catch (e) {}

        // immediate: true — fires synchronously right after page_view
        IM.track('view_category', {
          immediate: true,
          events: ['view_category', 'event191'],
          event_action: 'view_category',
          event_location: IM.notApply(categoryName),
          ecommerce: {},
        });
      }

      return { init: init };
    })();

    IM.customizationWidget = (function () {
      var firedImpression = false;
      var isTrackingClick = false;

      function getBlockPosition() {
        try {
          var el = document.querySelector('.kcw__section[data-block-position]');
          return el ? el.getAttribute('data-block-position') : 'not apply';
        } catch (e) {
          return 'not apply';
        }
      }

      function getDynamicLocation() {
        var path = window.location.pathname;
        if (path.indexOf('/collections') > -1 || path === '/' || path === '') {
          return 'home';
        }
        return IM.getPageType ? IM.getPageType() : 'home';
      }

      function getActiveWidgetData() {
        var widgetObj = window.kitCustomizationWidget;
        if (!widgetObj || !widgetObj.state) {
          console.warn('[DEBUG] getActiveWidgetData: widgetObj or state missing');
          return null;
        }

        var s = widgetObj.state;
        var kit = s.selectedKit || {};
        var variant = s.selectedVariant || {};
        var quality = s.selectedQuality || {};
        var competition = s.selectedCompetition || {};
        var checkedRadio = document.querySelector('.kcw__competition-options input[type="radio"]:checked');
        // Fallback: leer el radio seleccionado por defecto si el state no tiene competición
        if (!competition.handle && checkedRadio) {
          competition = {
            handle: checkedRadio.value || null,
            badgePrice: parseInt(checkedRadio.dataset.badgePrice || '0', 10),
          };
        }
        // FIX: Improving pide el label legible ("LaLiga Winners") en vez del
        // handle/slug. El estado interno del widget (selectedCompetition.handle)
        // trae el atributo "value" del radio tal cual, que es basura sin
        // espacios (ej. "LaLigaWinners Home 2627", el nombre interno del
        // producto del parche, no la competicion). El nombre limpio real vive
        // en el DOM, dentro de <span class="kcw__competition-name">. Lo leemos
        // siempre de ahi primero, independientemente de lo que traiga el state.
        var competitionLabel = null;
        if (checkedRadio) {
          var nameSpan =
            checkedRadio.closest('label') && checkedRadio.closest('label').querySelector('.kcw__competition-name');
          if (nameSpan) competitionLabel = nameSpan.textContent.trim();
        }
        if (!competitionLabel) {
          competitionLabel = competition.handle
            ? competition.handle.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, function (c) {
                return c.toUpperCase();
              })
            : null;
        }
        var activeProd = s.fictitiousProduct || s.baseProduct || {};

        var subtotalEl = document.querySelector('.kcw__subtotal-price');
        var rawPrice = subtotalEl ? subtotalEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9,.]/g, '').replace(',', '.') : '0';
        var subtotalPrice = IM.toNumber(rawPrice);

        var sku = 'not apply';
        if (
          s.baseProduct &&
          s.baseProduct.variants &&
          Array.isArray(s.baseProduct.variants) &&
          s.baseProduct.variants.length > 0
        ) {
          sku = s.baseProduct.variants[0].sku || 'not apply';
        } else if (activeProd.sku) {
          sku = activeProd.sku;
        }

        var kitHandle = kit.handle || 'not apply';
        var formattedKitVariant = kitHandle !== 'not apply' ? kitHandle + '_kit' : 'not apply';
        var formattedQualityTier = quality.label ? quality.label.toLowerCase() : 'not apply';

        var selectedSize = 'not apply';
        var sizeEl = document.querySelector('input[name="kcw-size"]:checked');
        if (sizeEl && sizeEl.parentElement) {
          selectedSize = sizeEl.parentElement.querySelector('span').textContent.trim();
        }

        var playerVal = 'not apply';
        if (s.playerReference) {
          playerVal = s.playerName;
        } else if (s.playerName || s.playerNumber) {
          playerVal = 'personalizado';
        }

        return {
          item_sku: IM.notApply(sku),
          item_id: IM.notApply(activeProd.id ? String(activeProd.id).split('/').pop() : kit.id),
          item_name: IM.notApply(activeProd.title || kit.handle),
          price: IM.notApply(subtotalPrice),
          quantity: 1,
          original_price: IM.notApply(parseFloat(s.baseProduct?.price || 0) / 100),
          discount_percentage: 0,
          discount_applied: 0,
          discount_type: IM.notApply(null),
          item_brand: 'fc barcelona',
          item_affiliate_name: 'fc barcelona',
          item_list_type: 'customization_widget',
          item_list_name: 'shirt_customization',
          index: 1,
          // Este widget solo vende equipaciones -> siempre "Yes"
          is_kit: 'Yes',
          personalized_item: s.playerName || s.playerNumber || s.playerReference ? 'yes' : 'no',
          // --- AQUÍ ESTÁN LOS MAPPINGS EXACTOS DE ITEMS PARA ADD_TO_CART ---
          kit: IM.notApply(formattedKitVariant),
          quality: IM.notApply(formattedQualityTier),
          genre: IM.notApply(variant.targetGenderHandle),
          item_size: IM.notApply(selectedSize),
          player: IM.notApply(playerVal),
          patch: IM.notApply(competition.handle || null),
          competitionLabel: IM.notApply(competitionLabel),
          price_patch: IM.notApply(competition.badgePrice ? competition.badgePrice / 100 : null),
          // FIX: confirmado en PRO que window.kitCustomizationWidget.customizationPrice
          // ya viene en euros (20), no en centimos - la division entre 100 producia
          // 0.2 en vez de 20 (el "0'2?" reportado por Improving).
          price_player: IM.notApply(
            s.playerName || s.playerNumber || s.playerReference
              ? widgetObj.customizationPrice || s.customizationPrice || 0
              : null
          ),
        };
      }

      function bindKitClicks() {
        var container = document.querySelector('.kcw__selector-group--kits');
        if (!container) return;
        container.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          var btn = e.target.closest('.kcw__selector--kit');
          if (!btn || isTrackingClick) return;
          isTrackingClick = true;
          setTimeout(function () {
            var itemData = getActiveWidgetData();
            if (itemData) {
              IM.track('select_kit', {
                events: ['event111'],
                event_location: getDynamicLocation(),
                event_action: 'select_kit',
                // Añadimos SOLO kit_name a eventData
                eventData: { kit_name: itemData.kit, block_position: getBlockPosition() },
                // Vaciamos el array de items
                ecommerce: { items: [] },
              });
            }
            setTimeout(function () {
              isTrackingClick = false;
            }, 800);
          }, 400);
        });
      }

      function bindVariantClicks() {
        var container = document.querySelector('.kcw__selector-group--variant');
        if (!container) return;
        container.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
          if (e.target.tagName !== 'INPUT') return;
          setTimeout(function () {

            // usuario en el boton (ej. "Men", no "men")
            var variantVal = window.kitCustomizationWidget.state.selectedVariant.label;

              event_action: 'select_variant',

              eventData: { variant: IM.notApply(variantVal), block_position: getBlockPosition() },
              // Vaciamos el array de items
              ecommerce: { items: [] },
            });
          }, 400);
        });
      }

      function bindQualityClicks() {

      function bindCompetitionClicks() {

      function bindCustomizationClicks() {

      function bindAddToCart() {
        var addBtn = document.getElementById('kcw-add-to-cart-btn');
        if (!addBtn) return;
        addBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var itemData = getActiveWidgetData();
          if (itemData) {
            window.blockNextGeneralAddToCart = true;

            // EL ADD_TO_CART SE MANTIENE INTACTO, ENVIANDO EL ITEM COMPLETO
            IM.track('add_to_cart', {
              events: ['scAdd', 'event174'],
              event_location: getDynamicLocation(),
              eventData: { block_position: getBlockPosition() },
              event_action: 'add_to_cart',
              ecommerce: {
                currency: 'EUR',
                value: itemData.price,
                items: [itemData], // Aquí sí pasamos el producto completo
              },
            });
            setTimeout(function () {
              window.blockNextGeneralAddToCart = false;
            }, 2000);
          }
        });
      }

      function trackImpression() {
        if (firedImpression) return;

        var itemData = getActiveWidgetData();
        var subtotalEl = document.querySelector('.kcw__subtotal-price');

        if (!itemData || !subtotalEl || subtotalEl.textContent === '---' || subtotalEl.textContent === '') {
          setTimeout(trackImpression, 500);
          return;
        }

        firedImpression = true;

        // REVERTIDO a peticion expresa (contradice el KO original de Improving
        // "no deberia llevar parametros de item", pero se ha confirmado que
        // ahora si quieren el item completo en esta impresion).
        IM.track('view_customization_widget', {
          events: ['event80'],
          event_location: getDynamicLocation(),
          event_action: 'view_customization_widget',
          eventData: {
            block_position: getBlockPosition(),
          },
          ecommerce: { items: [itemData] },
        });
      }

      function initVisibilityObserver() {
        var target = document.querySelector('.kcw__section');
        if (!target) {
          console.error('[DEBUG] Could not find .kcw__section to observe visibility.');
          return;
        }

        var observer = new IntersectionObserver(
          function (entries) {
            entries.forEach(function (entry) {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                trackImpression();
                observer.unobserve(entry.target);
              }
            });
          },
          { threshold: 0.5 }
        );

        observer.observe(target);
      }

      function init() {
        IM.waitFor(
          function () {
            return (
              window.kitCustomizationWidget &&
              window.kitCustomizationWidget.state &&
              window.kitCustomizationWidget.state.baseProduct
            );
          },
          { timeout: 10000, interval: 500 }
        ).then(function (exists) {
          if (exists) {
            initVisibilityObserver();
            bindKitClicks();
            bindVariantClicks();
            bindQualityClicks();
            bindSizeClicks();
            bindCustomizationClicks();
            bindCompetitionClicks();
            bindAddToCart();
          }
        });
      }

      return { init: init };
    })();

    IM.consentUpdateNotifier = (function () {
      var notified = false;

      function fireExtraPageView() {
        if (notified) return;
        notified = true;
        IM.track('page_view', {
          immediate: true,
          events: ['page_view', 'event4'],
          event_action: 'load',
          event_location: IM.getPageType(),
          ecommerce: { items: [], value: null },
        });
      }

      function init() {
        try {
          IM._pageViewDone.then(function () {
            IM.waitFor(
              function () {
                var dl = window.dataLayerIM || [];
                for (var i = dl.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                  if (dl[i].event === 'page_view') return true;
                }
                return false;
              },
              { timeout: 6000, interval: 100 }
            ).then(function () {
              var dl = window.dataLayerIM || [];
              var lastConsent = null;
              for (var i = dl.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (dl[i].event === 'page_view') {
                  lastConsent = dl[i].context && dl[i].context.cookies_consent;
                  break;
                }
              }

              if (lastConsent === true) return;
              var pollInterval = setInterval(function () {
                if (IM.getConsentAnalytics() === true) {
                  clearInterval(pollInterval);
                  fireExtraPageView();
                }
              }, 500);
              setTimeout(function () {
                clearInterval(pollInterval);
              }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
            });
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      return { init: init };
    })();

    IM.init = function () {
      IM.footer.init();
      IM.initFirstEntryUrl();
      IM.prefillIdentityFromGlobals();
      IM.identityCapture.init();

      IM.cart.refresh('manual');
    };

  })();

    function areAllConsentValuesEmpty(c) {
      if (!c) return true;
      for (const k in c) if (c[k] !== '') return false;
      return true;
    }

    function computeCategoryConsentAny(map) {
      const enabled = (window.Didomi && Didomi.getUserStatus && Didomi.getUserStatus()?.vendors?.global?.enabled) || [];
      const any = (ids) => (ids || []).some((id) => enabled.includes(id));
      return {
        analytics: any(map.analytics),
        marketing: any(map.marketing),
        preferences: any(map.preferences),
        sale_of_data: false,
      };
    }

    function computeTarget() {
      const api = Shopify.customerPrivacy;
      const current = api.currentVisitorConsent();
      const defaults = { analytics: false, marketing: false, preferences: false, sale_of_data: false };
      const target = areAllConsentValuesEmpty(current) ? defaults : computeCategoryConsentAny(vendorCategories);
      return target;
    }

    function apply() {
      const api = Shopify && Shopify.customerPrivacy;
      if (!api || !api.setTrackingConsent || !api.currentVisitorConsent) {
        return;
      }
      const target = computeTarget();
      const key = JSON.stringify(target);
      if (state.last === key) return;
      state.last = key;
      api.setTrackingConsent(target, () => {});
    }

    function waitFor(cond, timeout = 15000, step = 50) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const t0 = Date.now();
        (function loop() {
          if (cond()) return resolve();
          if (Date.now() - t0 > timeout) return reject(new Error('timeout'));
          setTimeout(loop, step);
        })();
      });
    }

    function onDidomiReady(cb) {
      window.didomiOnReady = window.didomiOnReady || [];
      window.didomiOnReady.push(cb);
    }

    async function bootstrap() {
      if (state.bootstrapped) return;
      state.bootstrapped = true;
      try {
        await waitFor(() => window.Shopify && Shopify.loadFeatures, 15000);
        await new Promise((res, rej) =>

        );
        apply();
        onDidomiReady(apply);
      } catch (e) {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => apply());
      }
    }

    window.didomiEventListeners = window.didomiEventListeners || [];
    window.didomiEventListeners.push({ event: 'consent.changed', listener: apply });

  })();
